notes: storyDescriptionBlurb is one blurb family for story/summary game modes.
Future modes should add sibling keys on each entry (e.g. characterBlurb) rather than replacing this file shape.
Canonical publisher description stays on the manhwa record and is the final unlock.
Relational import: one row per (manhwa_id, blurb_type, tier) from entries[].storyDescriptionBlurb.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: In a world of hunters and monsters, an underpowered fighter barely survives until a disastrous raid changes what he is capable of.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: After his party is wiped in a dungeon that should have been manageable, a mysterious interface begins handing him quests, rewards, and a way to grow stronger through clear conditions.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A quiet office worker who lived inside stories finds the world rewriting itself into the kind of crisis he used to read about.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The disaster unfolds in staged scenarios with rules, clear conditions for survival, and other people scrambling without the context he brings from years of reading.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Someone enters a vast trial that promises whatever you desire most, if you can keep rising through it.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Each floor is a new test of strength, loyalty, and ambition, and the higher you go, the clearer it becomes that the prize was never the only thing being measured.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A frail teenager already targeted by bullies at school carries a secret far darker than anything happening in the classroom.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The danger hiding at home wears a familiar face, and staying quiet about it might be the only thing keeping him alive.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A low-ranked climber in a tower full of ranked fighters gains a rare power that lets him borrow another person's skill, but only by paying with his own life.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Dying does not end things for him: each death sends him back to try again, stacking copied abilities as he claws his way toward the top.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A modern student falls asleep reading a fantasy novel and wakes up inside the story, in the body of a debt-ridden, lazy young noble.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He starts applying real-world engineering know-how to fix his new family's problems, quietly turning failing lands and mounting debts into something workable.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: In a ruined world where almost everything has been lost, two young survivors find a reason to keep moving forward together.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Cruel, broken adults threaten what little hope they have built, testing how long two kids can hold onto each other against constant despair.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A boy who lost his parents young was raised in a brutal foreign warzone, forced to grow up fighting just to survive.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Years later he returns to a peaceful home country and finds an ordinary high school somehow harder to navigate than the battlefield he left behind.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A withdrawn teen is forced out of isolation into a world that has suddenly turned lethal.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Monsters born from twisted desires overrun the city, and he has to hold out with other survivors who would rather not be heroes at all.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A skilled young martial artist enters a nationwide fighting tournament that promises the winner anything they desire.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: What starts as a straightforward contest between rising fighters slowly reveals a far bigger, stranger conspiracy behind who is really running the show.

entries.title: A Returner's Magic Should Be Special

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After a war against a world-ending catastrophe ends in near total defeat, one of the last surviving mages wakes up years earlier than he should.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Armed with future knowledge and battle-hardened instincts far beyond his age, he quietly outclasses classmates who have no idea what is coming.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A veteran gamer whose favorite title is fading finds that same game abruptly overtaking the real world, with everyone forced to play along.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He carries years of insider knowledge about its mechanics and enemies that no one else shares, giving him a serious edge as everyone scrambles to survive its trials.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: The lower-status son of a martial clan leader competes against powerful half-siblings for a coveted position within a prestigious school.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A strange injection from someone claiming to be his own descendant unlocks technology centuries ahead of its time, quietly reshaping how he fights.

entries.title: The Legend of the Northern Blade

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: The heir to a once-respected order loses everything when his sect is disbanded and his father is forced to take his own life to protect him.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: After years of secluded training in the mountains, he returns to civilization chasing both a lost ally and a reckoning with those who destroyed his home.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A bullied outsider gets a sudden chance to move through the world as someone people finally take seriously.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He can switch between his old self and a taller, sharper form, and the gap between those lives starts pulling him into fights, status games, and secrets he has to protect.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A soft-hearted kid with abnormal reflexes keeps trying to help people in a city that hides a much rougher power scene.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: His new ally is a wanted ability user stuck as a fat house cat, sharp-tongued and impossible to ignore, and the two of them keep stumbling into fights bigger than either wanted.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Grieving a brother who died competing in a legendary tower, a young man discovers there was a betrayal behind that death.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A strange keepsake left behind lets him tap into power and knowledge his brother gathered, and he starts climbing that same tower to confront whoever was responsible.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A cautious man drops into a fantasy life that looks comfortable, then realizes the plot has something brutal reserved for him.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He recognizes the world from a novel he never finished, including a rising hero and a future beating meant for the body he now occupies, so he starts steering events toward a quieter, richer survival.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A fighter with rough talent has to prove there is real heart behind the punches, not just raw ability.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Every match strips away excuses, forcing him to confront exactly how far his determination can carry him against tougher, more polished opponents.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Towers appear worldwide and unleash monsters, forcing fragile survivors to decide whether to keep fighting a losing war or escape into a different timeline.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: One stubborn fighter refuses the shortcut everyone else takes, choosing to stay in the original timeline and uncover unsettling secrets about where the towers came from.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Raised from childhood to kill without hesitation, a shunned member of an assassin family is betrayed and killed by his own blood.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Given an unexpected second chance at life with his old memories intact, he sets out to surpass the family that discarded him and settle the score with those who wronged him.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A martial prodigy is struck down in a last, desperate battle against a monstrous cult leader and does not expect to open his eyes again.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Waking up a century later, he finds his old school reduced to a shadow of what it once was, and sets about restoring its fallen reputation.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A model student with a spotless academic record gets pulled into a local crew built around competitive street riding.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Balancing his old reputation with this new after-school world starts testing loyalties he never expected to have to choose between.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A gamer who once looked down on weak, disposable characters gets pulled inside the very game he used to play, now living as one of them.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: To break free, he has to climb the ranks and eventually face down the very person controlling his fate from outside the game.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An heir to a renowned fighting clan is cast out for his lack of talent, then meets a grim end not long after finally overcoming his limits.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Waking up again as an infant with his memories intact, he sets out to shape his future differently and reach the strength that eluded him the first time.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A devoted player of a romance game wakes up trapped inside its story as the most hated, endangered character in the entire cast.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Every path toward the story's romantic leads seems to end badly for her, so she has to use what she remembers about the game to dodge one deadly twist after another.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: The last fighter still standing against a merciless god of destruction falls in battle, seemingly ending any hope for the world.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Sent ten years into the past by amused gods who enjoyed watching him fight, he wakes up as a lowly slave with a chance to change how it all plays out.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A timid high schooler becomes the secret disciple of a powerful, secretive martial artist with a complicated past.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: His new teacher has deep, dangerous ties to an underground fighting society, and those old grudges start spilling into the student's ordinary school life.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A woman who read a tragic novel wakes up as its ill-fated infant heir to a throne, remembering exactly how that story is supposed to end for her.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: To dodge her scripted execution, she has to win over a beautiful, tyrannical father who has no idea his own daughter is quietly planning around him.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An orphan abandoned as a baby is raised by a family of monster hunters and grows up obsessed with the history of a power he was never supposed to touch.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A chance meeting teaches him how to reach a hidden inner state that most spellcasters need noble blood to even attempt, opening a path meant to be closed to him.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: The most powerful spellcaster of his age is cursed to slowly lose his mind, then wakes up several millennia later in a completely different, far weaker body.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He finds magical progress has barely moved in all that time, and starts suspecting the being who cursed him might be behind that suspicious stagnation.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A perpetually unlucky low-level player in a popular virtual reality game stumbles onto an item that unlocks a rare and coveted class.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: His new skill for crafting exceptional equipment for himself and others starts drawing the kind of fame and rivalry he never actually wanted.

entries.title: The Return of the Disaster-Class Hero

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Unknown destructive creatures start appearing across the world, and gods respond by awakening a set of chosen champions to fight them off.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: One unlisted, unchosen fighter turns out to be the strongest of them all, and decades after being betrayed and left for dead, he comes back for a reckoning with his former allies.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Ancient underground ruins begin appearing worldwide, each hiding relics that grant supernatural power to whoever claims them first.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A seasoned relic hunter betrayed by his own employer is thrown fifteen years into the past, arriving before any of the ruins have even surfaced and determined to use that head start for payback.

entries.title: The Player Who Can't Level Up

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A newly invited tower participant with a supposedly special ability finds himself stuck at the very bottom rank for years while everyone around him climbs past him.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: After discovering he can link with strange inner personas to boost his stats, he starts turning years of being underestimated into an unlikely advantage.

entries.title: Latna Saga: Survival of a Sword King

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A recently discharged, aimless young man is suddenly pulled into another world and given a support system meant to guide his survival.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Glitches in that system trap him in a beginner stage for two decades, and by the time he finally breaks free, the world has turned hostile toward people like him.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Someone wakes from an extraordinarily long sleep to a quiet new life as a student at a school run by an old, devoted servant.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: That peace does not last: mysterious organized attackers soon start targeting the school and everyone connected to him.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A warrior gives his life protecting a rival, extracting a promise that the remaining great evils will eventually be wiped out.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Reborn three centuries later with his old memories intact, he discovers those threats never actually disappeared and finds himself training within the very bloodline he once fought beside.

entries.title: The Lazy Lord Masters the Sword

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After witnessing a devastating loss as a child, a young noble retreats into constant sleep to avoid facing the world, earning a mocking nickname.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A recurring dream about a mysterious swordsman starts to pull him out of that shell, setting him on a path he never expected to want.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An apparently ordinary college student has had strange dreams for years about fighting monsters and growing stronger, dreams he always brushed off as nothing.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: When a sudden monster outbreak hits his campus, that half-remembered ability turns out to be real, and a new system begins guiding him through his first taste of combat.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A powerful ruler from the underworld finally returns to the human world he once knew, only to find his powers stripped away.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The modern world has turned into a brutal survival game full of portals and monster hunts, forcing him to grind his way back to strength like everyone else.

entries.title: The Max Level Hero Strikes Back!

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A wounded, powerless prince falls into a coma, and his consciousness ends up somewhere legendary heroes are forged through brutal training.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Waking back in his own body and his own time, he returns to a royal court full of enemies who still think of him as harmless.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A streetwise orphan in a prosperous but corrupt trading town loses everything when a disgraced fighter destroys the place he works.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Turning to swordsmanship for survival, he gains a sentient blade as a mentor and ends up serving one of the region's most powerful noble houses.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Someone wakes up inside a game as one of its minor, disowned villains and just wants to quietly earn enough to graduate and move on.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Several of the story's central female characters keep seeking him out anyway, and his mere presence starts visibly bending the game's original plot.

entries.title: The Reason Why Raeliana Ended Up at the Duke's Mansion

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A young woman desperate for a better life is suddenly killed, only to wake up as a side character from a novel whose death kicks off the whole plot.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Refusing to repeat that fate, she starts making different choices early, determined to steer her new story away from the ending she already knows is coming.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A writer wakes up trapped inside his own unfinished story, living it as a minor background character instead of the hero he created.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Knowing the plot inside and out should make survival easy, but small details keep drifting away from what he originally wrote, unsettling his sense of control.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A scrawny, unassuming student stumbles into an online fighting channel that turns out to have surprisingly effective coaching behind it.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Following its advice lets him start beating people much stronger than him, and the growing fame and money raise the question of how long his luck can hold.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A high-ranking warrior suffers a crushing defeat that convinces him some powers may simply be unbeatable, but he refuses to quit.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Choosing to start completely over as a returning novice, he regrinds his skills from scratch, aiming to face the same trial again with a different outcome.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: The lone survivor of a catastrophic last stand against giant invaders is given a chance to relive his youth entirely.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Sent back to enroll in a prestigious school this time, he trains with knowledge of a war that has not happened yet, aiming to be ready when it finally comes.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A directionless adult worn down by family pressure to settle down ends up making an impulsive, life-changing proposal to solve the problem.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The old friend on the other end of that impulsive deal actually says yes, and the two of them have to figure out whether their sudden marriage could become something real.

entries.title: The Return of the 8th Class Mage

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A formidable spellcaster is poisoned by the ruler he once served loyally and turns to forbidden magic to escape death.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Reduced to a child again decades in the past, he enrolls in a school for young spellcasters to rebuild his strength before the betrayal can happen a second time.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Someone jolted out of her own life wakes up as the most disliked woman in a story she recognizes all too well.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Born into a powerful noble family with a reputation for cruelty, she decides to rewrite her fate on her own terms, ignoring the old rules and everyone who expects her to fail.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A martial artist chasing a legendary title dies fleeing enemies who wanted him silenced, then wakes up two decades younger.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: With memories of a future he already lived, he sets out to reach the pinnacle of his art without repeating the mistakes that got him killed the first time.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A fighter who sacrificed himself to stop a great threat wakes at last after decades sealed away in ice.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: New trial floors appeared while he was gone, nearly all still unbeaten, and he alone holds the means to clear the next one and revive the comrades still trapped beside him.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A creature who just wants an ordinary existence finds herself living in a world made lethal by a newer, wilder breed of her own kind.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She partners with a police officer to hunt down the bloodthirsty rogues terrorizing the city, and the alliance turns into something more heated than either expected.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: In a world where magic and technology blur together, ordinary people gain special powers to fight back against monstrous threats.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: One struggling, underpowered fighter stumbles onto a relic of extraordinary power that sets him on a path far beyond his humble beginnings.

entries.title: The Skeleton Soldier Failed to Defend the Dungeon

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A minor undead guardian dies protecting the person it serves, only to wake again two decades earlier with a second chance.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Lacking any real fighting skill and haunted by a history of failure, it sets out to warn the one it is sworn to protect and change the ending it already lived once.

entries.title: The Advanced Player of the Tutorial Tower

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Someone finally escapes after over a decade trapped inside a structure full of endlessly respawning monsters, now far stronger than anyone around him.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: His real goal is tracking down whoever locked him away in the first place, even if the search means cutting through armies of monsters and accidentally saving the world along the way.

entries.title: 66,666 Years: Advent of the Dark Mage

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A once-mighty spellcaster who was defeated and sealed away wakes up ages later inside the body of a newborn child.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Growing up gently in a loving family with only a sliver of his old power, he quietly plans to settle the score with the divine beings who imprisoned him.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A young man whose dream of becoming a warrior seemed impossible keeps dying, only to wake up at the start of that very same day.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: With endless replays of the same day to train and test himself in combat, he starts wondering just how far he can push his skills before the loop ever breaks.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An ordinary young man is pulled into a fantasy world run by demonic forces and given the role of a chosen champion.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: After beating the world's ultimate threat with surprising ease, he is told by the being who summoned him that a hidden evaluation reveals his true worth as champion required far more than raw strength.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A young noblewoman born from a scandalous match gets a second chance at childhood after watching her family fall into ruin.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Determined to win over a stern grandfather and stop her father's death before it happens, she sets her sights on eventually taking control of the household herself.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Someone with the worst stats in a deadly survival game has just one useful trick: he can read the hidden information of everyone else playing.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He latches onto a mysterious veteran who has secretly lived through this ordeal before, banking on that person's experience to drag them both past the early trials alive.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A struggling, low-ranked monster hunter stumbles into a virtual game through an old console and finds himself unable to log out.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The world inside turns out to run on the harsh, ranked rules of a martial arts hierarchy, forcing him to climb its brutal ladder just to find a way home.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A young man with no combat talent at all is dragged into a deadly maze like trial where only fighters are expected to thrive.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: After a strange glitch lets him cheat death, he starts picking up odd, unconventional abilities and gathers two unlikely companions, one fierce and dangerous, one small and oddly endearing.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A dedicated caretaker balancing family duties wins a full scholarship to an elite combat school that has just opened its doors to him as the only member of his gender.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The school's biggest draw is a brutal, nationally famous fighting tournament between its students, and he quickly gets tangled up with its reigning champion and the rest of its fierce, unconventional student body.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A once formidable martial artist believes his fighting days are over after losing the inner power he relied on, but old enemies from a secretive combat society still want him dead.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Tributes to a legendary fighter linked to his past begin appearing across the globe, forcing a coalition of martial factions to scramble before a shadowy strike force can trigger something much bigger.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Betrayed and killed by the very leader he once trusted, a player is given a chance to start the game over, this time chasing revenge instead of glory.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: His growing body count earns him fame within the game while masking exactly whose side he is really playing for, and everyone underestimates just how far he is willing to go to bring down the one at the top.

entries.title: The Reborn Young Lord is an Assassin

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An illegitimate noble son trained as a covert killer is betrayed by the very sibling he always deferred to, and dies for it.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Waking up as a child again with all his old skills intact, he resolves this time to step out of that sibling's shadow instead of quietly serving underneath him.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A noblewoman punished harshly for mistreating her stepsister discovers, too late, that she was manipulated into it all along.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Given a second chance through a strange timekeeping charm, she throws herself back into her old cruel role, this time aiming it squarely at the sister who set her up.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A man of many false identities takes on yet another disguise, becoming a teacher at a prestigious school under a dead man's name.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The identity he has borrowed turns out to be tied to a shadowy secret society, and he must keep dodging both the school's suspicion and the danger that comes with it.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: In an empire simmering with tension between the crown and its temple, a noblewoman who lost her place at the prince's side refuses to give up quietly.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She sets her sights on reclaiming the exact position and title that were taken from her, whatever scheming it takes to get back what she considers rightfully hers.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An average teenager suddenly gains the ability to see everyday life through the lens of a video game.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He discovers a hidden community of people who share this same strange perception, and now has to juggle ordinary schoolwork with quests that push him to grow stronger in the real world.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An orphan wandering alone is knocked out by a stranger and wakes up locked inside a bare, windowless cell.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Once the door finally opens, he learns he is one of hundreds of kidnapped children being forged into weapons, and only the strongest few will be allowed to survive the selection.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A popular college student hides a strange secret beneath his perfect image: wings that sprouted after exposure to an unusual chemical.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: After exposing himself to save a stranger, he discovers a hidden society of people like him, where survival depends on ruthless, animalistic rules rather than the polish he is used to.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: In a world split between those with heroic powers and those who wield their abilities for harm, a righteous fighter wakes up trapped inside the body of someone who just crossed over to the wrong side.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Stuck now as a fresh face on that darker side of the divide, he has to decide whether his old sense of justice can survive inside a role built for causing harm.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A bullied teenager fleeing through the woods stumbles onto a weapon and just enough ammunition to matter.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He returns to find his tormentors under attack by flesh craving creatures, and suddenly he is the only thing standing between his classmates and being devoured.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: At a school run by cruel upperclassmen who prey on the weak, a new student arrives who does not fit the mold of a typical troublemaker.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Small and unassuming but coldly calculating in a fight, he starts taking down the school's toughest bullies one by one, forcing the old order to scramble in response.

entries.title: The Regressed Mercenary Has a Plan

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A renowned fighter is killed in battle before he can settle a score with the man who destroyed his family, then wakes up as his own teenage self.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Saddled early on with a bad reputation and a crumbling group of soldiers ready to abandon him, he has to rebuild both his strength and his standing from almost nothing.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A struggling high school student who can barely afford basic necessities still clings to a childhood dream of becoming someone extraordinary.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A chance encounter with a strange, almost otherworldly performer at a fair reignites that old wish and pulls her toward a very different way of seeing the world.

entries.title: The 100th Regression of the Max-Level Player

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Trapped in a merciless death game meant for young people, one competitor has already reached the final stage dozens of times without ever truly winning.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Each attempt ends the same cruel way because he lacks enough companions at the final gate, so this time he is focused on finding the right people to stand with him instead of going it alone.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A minor background character in a game world knows its every detail and quietly benefits from riding alongside its central figure.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: When that central figure turns out to be secretly slaughtering innocents for personal gain, he is sent back several years with a new goal: stop him and take his place before the final battle even starts.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: With the world drowned beneath rising water, monstrous creatures now rule what is left of dry land.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A boy and his family fight to reach somewhere safe, but a mysterious figure connected to his past keeps pulling him back into danger.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A low ranked fighter constantly overshadowed by his far more talented sibling gets a rare chance to rewind time after a disastrous mission costs him everything.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Determined just to live quietly this time, he instead finds himself gathering and training a circle of extraordinarily powerful allies almost by accident.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A royal wife who played every role perfectly is discarded the moment someone newer arrives.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Public divorce becomes a political weapon, and she answers humiliation with a move that keeps her power instead of sending her into exile.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: The downfall of a scheming, criminal noble family has already been written into the story she finds herself trapped inside.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: When someone tied to her one chance at survival gets kidnapped by her own father, she has to decide whether to trust a stranger caught in the crossfire of her family's crimes.

entries.title: How to Win My Husband Over

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After a fatal accident, someone wakes up inside the body of a side character from a novel destined to be killed by her own future husband.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Forced to survive both a dysfunctional noble family and an unavoidable marriage to her killer to be, she sets out to convince everyone around her that she poses no threat at all.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A skilled but disabled fighter is betrayed and imprisoned for life after winning an honorable duel against a jealous relative.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Centuries later, his soul is unexpectedly pulled into the body of a young boy tied to a minor deity, and the two must work together to relearn combat and uncover the truth behind an old betrayal.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A decade after gods forced humanity into a deadly game where losing means dying for real, one survivor has already watched everyone else fail.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Given a chance to relive it all from the very beginning, he sets out this time to change the outcome and turn the tables on the very gods who created the game.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A legendary overlord from a brutal martial world wakes up reincarnated as the dim witted, luxury obsessed son of a minor noble.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Determined to shake up his new, softer surroundings, he searches for answers about why fate placed him in this pampered new life at all.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A collection of young romances unfolds across the changing year, each one intense, messy, and a little confusing.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The stories follow different couples navigating first feelings, mixed signals, and the awkward, tender moments of figuring out what they actually want from each other.

entries.title: Blink Master of the Magic Academy

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Inside a game world, one player is considered nearly useless because he cannot use magic the way everyone else can.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: His only ability is a short, unglamorous teleport that most consider a joke, yet he is determined to ride that one overlooked skill all the way to the game's hidden true ending.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A powerless young man works a dangerous job as living bait for powerful fighters, just to pay for his sick mother's care.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: At the brink of death, memories of an entirely different life flood back to him, revealing that he was once a legendary ruler with command over arcane power.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A widow who spent years quietly raising children who were not her own, and who never accepted her, finally sees her responsibilities lifted, only to learn she has been cast aside completely.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A sudden death sends her back seven years to the day of her husband's funeral, giving her a chance to handle those same difficult years very differently this time.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A reclusive fan whose online reputation was destroyed retreats deep into a world of fiction to cope with crushing anxiety.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Transported into another world entirely, he finds his anxiety mysteriously gone and discovers he has become the most powerful being to ever arrive there, serving an unexpectedly fragile counterpart who brought him over.

entries.title: The Martial God Who Regressed Back to Level 2

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After humanity loses a losing fight against a deadly system that turned the world into a game, one fighter gets sent back a few years before it all began.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Armed with knowledge of exactly how things go wrong, he now races to become the strongest possible fighter in time, determined to protect the people he could not save before.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Years after a war between surface dwellers and those below ground ends, a man born with unusual abilities chooses to live an ordinary life instead of embracing them.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A disastrous expedition unexpectedly puts him in charge of a sprawling underground labyrinth, and he starts to realize he cannot keep suppressing the instincts he was born with.

entries.title: Doctor Elise: The Royal Lady with the Lamp

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A brilliant surgeon trying to atone for a cruel past life dies in an accident and wakes up back in that very past life, years before her own downfall.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Armed now with modern medical knowledge she never had before, she sets out to undo the arrogant mistakes that once destroyed her and everyone around her.

entries.title: Surviving the Game as a Barbarian

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After years spent mastering a role playing game that no one has ever finished, a player finally reaches the doorstep of its final challenge.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Instead of the ending he expected, he is suddenly thrust into the body of one of the game's own rugged in world warriors, forced to live by that world's rules from the inside.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A renowned warrior who ended a brutal civil war is betrayed and nearly killed by the very comrades who once feared him.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A strange flash from his signature weapon sends him back to the stables of his childhood, giving him a chance to relive his rise to power and settle the score this time around.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A young woman drowns her heartbreak over a friend's new romance with one reckless, impulsive decision.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A single night leaves her pregnant, and the responsible, straight-laced man involved insists on marrying someone he barely knows to do right by her.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A martial arts disciple watches his teacher executed on a false charge and dies trying to avenge him.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He opens his eyes again as a child, raised within the very order blamed for that crime, and has to master the forbidden techniques he once condemned if he ever wants a real shot at revenge.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A gamer with a failing body throws himself into an online world he can already navigate in his sleep, with nothing left to lose.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Waking up as his own in-game character, he realizes he's fighting for two lives at once, and pushes to give that digital self a future neither of them was supposed to get.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A broke, penny-pinching gamer loses everything to debt collectors and throws himself into a brand-new virtual world to rebuild his fortune.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Determined never to end up poor again, he stumbles into a rare, overlooked crafting path that quietly turns him into one of that world's most influential figures.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: At a rough vocational school where survival matters more than grades, one determined student refuses to give up on getting into college.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: After being turned down by every existing prep circle, he starts one of his own, just as his former tutor arrives at the same school chasing her own teaching credentials.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After spending centuries fighting monsters in another world, someone finally makes it back home.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The homecoming isn't a lonely one, and whatever followed him back makes it clear the peace he expected won't last.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A woman with a speech impediment enters an arranged marriage, only for her husband to vanish on campaign right after the wedding.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: When he returns years later determined to finally love her properly, she can't shake the doubt that she's earned any of the happiness now being offered.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A young man who lost his family to a mysterious catastrophe spends years training to fight monsters, only to discover his effort has gotten him nowhere.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Just as he's ready to give up, an invitation pulls him into a floating trial realm where challengers face off against both monsters and each other.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A grieving young man is transformed into something violent and merciless after his grandfather's brutal death.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Determined but still untrained, he has to master real martial arts fast if his rage alone is ever going to be enough to catch the man responsible.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An ordinary reader leaves a comment online and somehow wakes up inside the very story he was reading.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He finds himself living as the lead of a serialized comic, with no idea how much of the plot he can actually change from the inside.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A man wakes up on a beautiful beach with no memory of who he is or how he got there.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The family that takes him in seems welcoming enough, but every answer he digs up only raises stranger, more unsettling questions about where he really is.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A burned-out former professional gamer receives a strange invitation to a game world and, out of habit, picks the hardest setting available.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Trapped with an almost impossible survival rate, he starts to suspect this so-called warm-up round is hiding a much bigger reason he was pulled in.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: The heir to a family of spellcasters can't perform any magic at all because of a rare condition.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: While chasing a cure, he accidentally absorbs a trapped, scheming spirit that had been trying to take him over instead, and now the two are stuck sharing one body.

entries.title: Father, I Don't Want this Marriage

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A woman despised by everyone around her gets a second chance right before her miserable story was set to end.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Instead of clinging to her family for approval, she decides to spend her father's fortune enjoying her freedom, and strikes up a pretend courtship with his top student to steer clear of the suitor being lined up for her.

entries.title: Tyrant of the Tower Defense Game

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A star streamer becomes the first to clear a legendarily brutal strategy game on its hardest setting.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Yanked into that same world and stuck inside a prince's body, he's horrified to learn that every unit he once sacrificed without a thought was a real, living person.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A feared fighter known for leaving nothing but destruction behind him is killed mid battle by a shot that shouldn't have been possible.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Brought back years later in the body of an unimpressive teenager, he finds that school bullies and shady deals can be just as brutal as any battlefield he used to know.

entries.title: My Bias Gets on the Last Train

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A commuter's repetitive nightly ride is interrupted by a girl with a guitar who keeps catching his eye.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A shared love of one obscure band pulls them closer, but she's hiding that she's the voice behind that very group, a secret that could unravel everything.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A woman carries the memories of every one of her many past lives, along with the skills and bonds she built in each.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Guided by an unfinished romance from her last life, she sets out to win it back, only to find her fiercest rival might be an earlier version of herself.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A young woman stuck dating someone who barely notices her starts comparing her dull life to her more charismatic stepsister's.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A talking phone she finds becomes an unlikely relationship coach just as she grows closer to her boyfriend's friend and starts suspecting he's involved with her stepsister.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A bullied gamer is worked to exhaustion fetching virtual loot for the people who torment him.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: After collapsing from the strain, he wakes up a week in the past with every skill he ever built up now somehow usable outside the game.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A teenager who ranks near the bottom of his school in every category gets an unexpected offer from a popular new classmate.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He's pulled into a secret contest where risking a random draw can instantly reshape someone's strength, luck, or standing.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A teenager who lost his family and the use of his legs in an accident is reincarnated into a violent, ancient world.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: After rising to legendary power there and dying again, he wakes back in his original life, before the accident, with all that strength and skill somehow carried over.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A former soldier trying to live a normal student life is suddenly forced into a strange, unexplained trial alongside his whole class.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Given a rare choice of role in the crisis, he picks the path of commanding the dead, and has to use that unsettling power to keep his classmates alive.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A government official with unusually rough methods gets called in whenever ordinary punishments fail to stop school bullies.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Sent from school to school, this enforcer treats every bullying case as a problem to be solved with fists first and paperwork later, no matter how young the offender.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A tired, overworked woman finds herself trapped inside a romance novel as the story's antagonist.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Every attempt to end that character's fate for good gets blocked by the plot itself, so she sets off with an odd band of companions to find another way out.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: In a world split between costumed protectors and those who oppose them, one girl sets out alone on a violent path.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Her fight for personal revenge keeps blurring the line between the two sides, until it's no longer clear who actually deserves to be called a protector.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A woman wakes up in the body of a novel's doomed antagonist, a role she recognizes because she's lived through this death once before, in a past life.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Refusing to die a third time, she starts quietly steering the people and schemes around her instead of waiting for the story to steer her.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: On the verge of death in a war between worlds, a young man is given a second chance at life, though he barely remembers why.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Guided only by scattered dreams of a future he hasn't lived yet and luck he never worked for, his fortune turns when that borrowed power finally runs dry.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A legendary swordsman who once toppled every rival worth naming is thrown back into his own past through a forbidden ritual.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Retracing the road that made him unbeatable, he now aims for more than raw power, mending broken relationships and rallying his people before an old, looming war returns.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Humanity's strongest surviving fighter, alone against a relentless monster invasion, eventually falls just like everyone else.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He wakes up decades earlier in the body of an unremarkable teenager, with no idea why he was sent back, only that he now has time to prevent the disaster properly.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A bullied gaming enthusiast who hates school starts receiving real-life prompts that mirror the missions from his favorite games.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: As the rewards grow bigger and the tasks grow riskier, he climbs from outcast to the top of the social ladder, though it's unclear what he's willing to do to stay there.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A being who has lived and died as countless different species across billions of years is finally reborn as the one species he despises most.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Armed with abilities inherited from every past life, he sets out to end humanity entirely, until a sudden accident wipes his memory and throws that plan into doubt.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A woman finds herself pulled into a novel she's read before, only to discover she's not the character she expected to be.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Stuck decades before the story she knows, and aware that almost everyone from her generation is fated to die, she decides the best fix is to charm her way into changing one particular man's future.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A shy fan of comics discovers a skill online that completely transforms how her classmates see her.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Enjoying her sudden popularity, she now has to keep her old self hidden, especially from one classmate who already knows exactly what she's covering up.

entries.title: The Reincarnated Assassin Is a Swordmaster

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A loyal killer betrayed and murdered by his own target wakes up again inside a rival, far wealthier household.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Alongside the powerful technique he brought with him, he's also carrying a deadly curse and sharing space with a violent spirit trying to claim his body.

entries.title: Legend of an Asura - The Poison Dragon

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A once-great healing order is wiped out by a rival group, and one of its members is turned into a living test subject.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Twisted by every poison forced into his body, he emerges as the sole survivor of his order, driven only by turning that same venom back on the ones responsible.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A powerful figure who reached the very top of a demanding world abruptly finds himself back at the very bottom.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Stripped of nearly everything he built, he now has to claw his way back up in a system where everyone above him still remembers exactly who he used to be.

entries.title: The Male Lead's Little Lion Daughter

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A terrifying, high-ranking noble surprises everyone by deciding to adopt a child from a rundown orphanage.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: As she settles into palace life and picks up her new family's skills, strange traits she can't explain start making her adoptive father suspicious of where she really came from.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: The disgraced outcast of his own clan is forced to serve as a low-level spy for a ruthless organization after his inner power is destroyed.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Killed on a mission and thrown a decade into his own past, he wakes with an unexpected new gift: he can hear a voice speaking to him from an ordinary blade.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Reality is suddenly torn open by rifts leaking monsters from a popular virtual game, and select people wake up as their old in-game characters.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: His awakened form turns out to be the painfully awkward avatar he made as a self-conscious middle schooler, complete with all its cringeworthy habits and catchphrases.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A powerful fighter comes home from saving another world only to find he's lost everything that mattered, and turns his fury on the people around him.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: One family destroyed in his rampage includes a teenager who is instead pulled into another world, trained into a fighter of his own, and eventually sent back to settle the score.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A noblewoman raised to fulfill a prophecy about a rare kind of power never quite earns her father's affection.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: After a rival shows up claiming her exact birthright and gets her killed for it, she wakes with a second chance to build genuine alliances before that betrayal can happen again.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Two close friends insist they're just that, friends, even as everyone around them seems to see something else entirely.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Small, lingering moments between them keep blurring a line neither one is willing to admit is already gone.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A man builds a fortune trading rare goods across different worlds, until the very people he trusted take it all, along with his life.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Waking up back in his younger body with everything he once knew intact, he starts climbing the ranks of that same market again, this time working toward revenge instead of riches.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A legendary competitor who once dominated a wildly popular online game walked away at the very top and quietly disappeared into an ordinary life.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: When a business rival wrecks his family's fortune, he's talked into going back to that same game as a total newcomer, chasing both a paycheck and payback.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: The heir of a respected noble house grows into one of the most feared and hated fighters of his era, eventually dying after being captured in a great war.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Waking up back at the very moment of his original death, he realizes some things have already shifted, though not necessarily enough to spare him the same regrets.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A princess framed for a crime she didn't commit is horrified when her own family decides she should die for it.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Reborn as royalty in a rival nation, she gains a strange new power and has to figure out whether her seemingly warm new family can actually be trusted before turning that power on the ones who betrayed her.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An infant abandoned in a cursed forest reserved for monsters and outcasts is raised against all odds by an unlikely pair of guardians.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A dark force growing inside him threatens to take over completely, so he picks up a blade not for glory but to keep himself from turning into the very thing that forest was built to contain.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Two rival gamers who once ranked at the very top of the same title find themselves waking up inside that very game's world.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: With the story's catastrophic finish already looming over them, the former rivals team up, combining sharp instincts and sharper mouths, to steer the plot somewhere softer.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An unremarkable day turns strange when a sudden catastrophe rips someone away to a completely different world.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Just as he adapts enough to survive there, he's yanked back home, only to find his own planet has been invaded by monsters in his absence.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A schemer who spent her life boosting her brother's rise to power is betrayed and locked away, only to open her eyes years earlier with time to undo it all.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She once traded her life through forbidden magic to help a nobleman topple a tyrant, and now, sent back before that sacrifice, she has to decide how much of her family she is willing to burn down while a new romance quietly takes root.

entries.title: My Daughter Is The Final Boss

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A father who failed to protect his family gets a second chance to raise his young daughter differently, this time knowing what she is fated to become.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He is handed a formal task to rewrite her fate before she turns dangerous, and failing at this quiet parenting job would end far more than just his own life.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A once-mighty being falls from grace and is offered a second job in the mortal world, sealing off threats trying to slip in from beyond.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Stripped of former rank and dropped back on earth in a human shell, he has to rebuild his old strength from nothing while unseen watchers size up whether he deserves a comeback.

entries.title: I'm Not That Kind of Talent

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A frail, sickly young man is mistaken for a legendary fighter and thrust into a role built on a reputation he never earned.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The mistake lands him at the top of an entire army's chain of command right as a full war between two very different peoples heats up, forcing him to fake the strength everyone assumes he has.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A driven fighter who protects people from monsters slipping out of a strange rift is pulled into a bargain that promises to make him strong enough to matter.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A powerful being from that rift strikes the deal after seeing a vision of catastrophe, sending him through grueling training inside the dangerous realm itself before he can earn a way back home.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A reader wakes up as the disposable side character of the romance she used to read, someone whose only job in the story was to cause trouble and then die.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Her actual goal now is engineering her own split with the man she is married to, all while dodging the novel's real leads and a fragile body that could do her in first.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A battle-scarred fighter who rose to run his old school looks back on a life of missed chances, then finds himself waking up decades before any of it happened.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: This time he carries every hard lesson from a future he no longer has to live through, and sets out to save the people and reputation he lost, one uphill fight at a time.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An overlooked adult stuck doing grunt work in a world ruled by combat ability finally gets handed real power by a mysterious benefactor.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Along with a fresh start in his teenage years, he gets an ability built around stealing and shutting down what other fighters can do, instead of any power of his own.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A young fighter sets out on a revenge mission armed with his teacher's secret techniques, ready to burn down anyone responsible.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: When he finally catches up to his enemies, he finds they are already dead at someone else's hands, leaving him adrift with nothing to do but carve out a new place among a tangle of rival fighters and hidden factions.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A student ranked at the very bottom of a school where power decides your entire social standing hides a secret that could flip that ranking overnight.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He is actually one of the most dangerous people around, but he buries that side of himself on purpose, choosing to stay at the bottom of the pecking order so the people near him stay safe.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A summoned outsider refuses to play the hero role a goddess picked him for, and gets abandoned in a hostile land for his defiance.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: An overlooked deity offers him real power instead, and his true motivation turns out to be getting home and settling a score with the one who betrayed him, not saving this world at all.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: The writer of a doomed romance wakes up inside her own story as the side character marked to die for the main couple's happy ending.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She saves the man meant to stand against the story's leads, turning him from threat to ally, all while trying to keep the ending she originally wrote from unraveling.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Someone's private stash of photos of a longtime crush gets discovered by the wrong person, and things spiral fast.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Instead of exposing him, the person who found it keeps using that secret as leverage, pulling him into one awkward situation after another until he starts wondering if it is teasing or something else entirely.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A once-feared commander from a brutal survival world returns home to find his old rank means nothing, reduced to grinding low-level missions for cash.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Guilds start scrambling to recruit him once his real abilities surface, and an enemy he made in that other world is coming through to finish what started there, putting his new home at risk.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A neglected daughter meant to be sacrificed for her favored sibling instead awakens a forbidden power no one in her family expected.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Rather than running, she strikes a bargain: her newfound power in exchange for a home and protection under a fearsome stranger, trading one kind of danger for another.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A top-ranked player is humiliated and stripped of everything he built, then a strange twist sends him back before the game he mastered even begins.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: With full knowledge of a game that has not even launched yet in this timeline, he plans every move years in advance, turning insider foresight into an unfair head start over people who once looked down on him.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A woman is handed over to a feared, monstrous lord to settle an old family debt, bracing herself for a nightmare marriage.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The terrifying reputation turns out to be mostly exaggeration, since the masked figure behind it is oddly gentle and clearly hiding something far less monstrous than his name suggests, leaving her to defend their home from real dangers while she figures out the truth.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A webcomic fan watches the story he reads spill into his own city when its heroine suddenly turns up in front of him.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The story's original hero never shows up to save her this time, so he has to take on that job himself, working from nothing but memory of a plot he only ever watched from the outside.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A man who finally gets his revenge dies right after, then wakes up back in his neglected childhood with everything still ahead of him.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He keeps every memory and skill from the life he already lived, using that head start to shield the handful of people who treated him well and go after the ones who wronged him, much sooner than before.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Someone dragged into a strange, game-like world years ago finally claws his way to its very top, only to find the cost was not worth it.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Instead of chasing the top spot again, he spends his hard-earned privilege at the summit to rewind a full decade, determined to fix a personal tragedy he could not stop the first time.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A doctor whose mission ends in death wakes up on a battlefield in a completely different, sword-and-fist world, still carrying his modern training.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Reborn this time as a child, it is his medical knowledge rather than any fighting skill that gets him noticed by dangerous factions, and he has to decide how far he will go, and what he will sacrifice, to keep using it.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A skilled killer trying to escape the organization that controls him is gravely wounded, then wakes up in someone else's body among people he used to fight against.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The new body carries a disorder that blocks him from using its power at all, forcing him to survive purely on old instincts while hiding among a den of rivals and schemers who would kill him if they knew who he really was.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A culinary master gets pulled into the game world he used to play, only to land in the body of a forgettable background character.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: His years of blade work in the kitchen turn out to translate almost directly into a new combat gift built entirely around cutting, letting a nobody extra fight in ways none of the game's real leads ever saw coming.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A gentle, hardworking single parent with a rough past just wants a quiet job that lets him keep his kids safe.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: When a shadowy group starts abducting children around the city, his old, far more dangerous set of skills comes back out, skills his quiet day job never let anyone suspect he had.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A veteran player who knows every shortcut in his favorite game dies suddenly, then wakes up living inside that same world as a minor, unimportant noble.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Knowing every flaw and hidden exploit that world was never supposed to reveal, he bends broken rules nobody born into it could ever find, turning a throwaway title into real leverage.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Someone pulled into another world with no useful abilities spends decades barely scraping by, then gets a rare chance to relive it all.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Even with full memory of everything that happened the first time through, no real gift or power comes with the reset, so he has to claw forward through pure stubbornness while everyone stronger stays just out of reach.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Years after a legendary group saved the world at great cost, the survivors with extraordinary gifts now have nowhere to use them except a competitive stage built just for show.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The fighter whose death was supposed to be permanent turns up alive years later, arriving just as his home country's standing in these staged competitions has fallen embarrassingly far from its old glory.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A game developer who added a few personal touches to one of his own characters ends up trapped inside that very character's fictional life.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The odds against this character making it out alive are laid out in exact, brutal terms, and now the developer has to gamble on whether the little tweaks he made before are enough to beat them.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A skilled marksman whose military career ends in a life-changing accident finds new purpose in a virtual world where in-game earnings carry real value.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He locks himself into the game's weakest starting option, then builds his whole comeback around old-fashioned, unglamorous gear nobody respects, betting that skill can make up for a class everyone else avoided.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Someone pulled into a game world ends up stuck with the single worst class available, one nobody else wanted.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The god he answers to has been reduced to little more than an unhinged, muttering relic, and a prophecy of coming ruin means the weakest class in the game might end up mattering a lot more than anyone assumed.

entries.title: My In-Laws are Obsessed with Me

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A noblewoman betrayed and killed by the people closest to her gets pulled back to a point in time before it happens, determined to change her fate.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: To stall her enemies, she marries into a different, feared noble family, only to discover a disturbing secret buried in that household as well, complicating her plan for a clean revenge.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A burned-out veteran discovers his miserable years grinding a game were just a bad dream, and wakes up as a beginner again with a second shot.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: This time he chases a loud, public reputation instead of grinding quietly, turning his second run into an aggressive, high-profile climb that draws both devoted fans and jealous rivals.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A battle-worn mercenary missing a limb consumes a strange artifact and wakes up whole again, back at the very start of his military career.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: What drives him is not personal glory but saving a handful of comrades he watched die the first time, using exact memories of coming battles and betrayals to steer his climb through the ranks differently.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An ordinary underdog stumbles into a monster-filled dungeon expecting danger, and ends up running an unlikely business instead.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Instead of climbing any combat ranking, he carves out a living growing and selling crops right inside the dungeon's economy, backed by a small crew of loyal animal companions.

entries.title: I Get Stronger the More I Eat

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Someone discovers he can absorb the abilities of dangerous creatures simply by consuming them, growing stronger with every strange meal.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: After being pulled into a fantasy world overrun with orcs, trolls, and worse, he sets his sights on working his way to the top of that world's monster hierarchy using exactly that method.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An ordinary part-time worker gets swept into a strange dimension when monsters start appearing everywhere, and trains there far longer than anyone would expect.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Thousands of years of training pass for him while only a decade goes by back home, and once he returns at the peak of his strength, what he actually wants is to repair the relationships he left broken, not chase more power.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A hardworking swordsman who cannot quite beat his more privileged rival at school gets chosen by a legendary weapon as its student.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Instead of sword techniques, his new mentor starts by trying to teach him to see in a way he currently cannot, an odd, almost spiritual lesson that has nothing to do with swinging a blade.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A feared ruler of a dangerous tower that many fighters have tried and failed to bring down starts to grow oddly fascinated with the people trying to kill him.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: After his eventual defeat at the hands of the fighter who finally manages it, he gets his own secret wish granted: waking up as a completely powerless, ordinary person, seeing life from the side he used to look down on.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A ruthless leader on his deathbed is reborn as a young disciple inside the very order that has always stood against everything he believed in.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He sets out to secretly corrupt the very order he is now part of from the inside, but its members keep responding to his scheming with a sincerity that starts to mess with his plan.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A woman drowning in work stress and family debt agrees to a strange favor: stand in for a friend on a blind date for money.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The stand-in date turns out to be with her own workplace superior, and he is serious about marrying whichever woman showed up that night, turning a one-time favor into an unplanned office entanglement.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Millions of players from a massive virtual game vanish overnight, and when they start reappearing, real monsters begin pouring into the world right alongside them.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Ordinary weapons prove useless against what is invading, leaving only game-earned abilities as real defense, and the strongest of the players who came back reassembles his old team to face both the monsters and the bigger threat pulling their strings.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A war orphan turned healer is summoned to secretly treat a reclusive figure nobody in the castle has ever laid eyes on.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: What he is really chasing is the person responsible for his parents' deaths years ago, and the closer he gets to answers, the more it looks like that enemy has been standing right beside him the whole time.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A noblewoman who has lived and died the same powerless role many times before finally stops bending to the people who have always controlled her.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: This time she inherits real, formal authority over her house along with an old sacred power, giving her the standing to move openly against the siblings who always exploited her instead of just quietly enduring them.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A retired killer trying to live a quiet, ordinary life is ambushed by the very organization he used to serve, and barely survives.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The near-fatal attack leaves his body mysteriously reset to its younger, strongest years, and instead of using that second wind to build a new life, he turns straight back around to settle accounts with the people who came after him.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A reader who wakes up as the lead of her favorite romance novel expects the story to play out exactly like the book.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: When the plot starts drifting away from how the book actually goes, she ends up depending on help from an unexpected classmate whose identity she cannot quite pin down, rather than the love interest the story was supposed to hand her.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A once-disgraced doctor gets an unexpected second chance at life, waking up back in his middle school years.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Rather than repeating the demanding, underpaid specialty that defined his last life, he sets his sights this time on a far more lucrative one, treating his second shot as a chance to finally get rich instead of just get by.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A dedicated player abandons his high-ranked character in a brutal virtual game to gamble on a class everyone else considers useless.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: With a personal deadline hanging over him outside the game, tied to his actual grades, he has to claw his way back up a notoriously slow, punishing ranking system in a fraction of the time it is supposed to take.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A reader wakes up as the minor, unlikable relative marked to die early in her favorite story, and plans to quietly get out of the way before that happens.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Her plan to quietly step aside falls apart when a child from the story refuses to let her go, pulling her into raising him herself and rewriting the tragedy her role was originally written to cause.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A cruel, self-centered noblewoman realizes too late how badly she treated her own household, then gets a second chance at the same life in her younger body.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: This time, the person at the center of her change of heart is the husband she used to take for granted while he fought and bled for their household, turning her second chance into something closer to reconciliation than revenge.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A once-feared warrior wakes from a centuries-long seal into a world that has completely forgotten who he was.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: After saving a dying child purely out of pity, he tries to build a quiet family life with her, but the martial world's competing factions refuse to leave the two of them alone, forcing his old reputation back to the surface.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A boy endures years of cruelty from his father's household for being born to the wrong mother, until a strange discovery gives him a way out.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A spirit hidden inside an old mirror teaches him a lost sword technique, and after a decade of secret training he flees to join a band of outlaws, only for his growing strength to draw new rivals.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Strange rifts have torn open across the world, spilling out hostile creatures and forcing ordinary people to adapt or die.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: To cover his sick father's bills, a teenager secretly smuggles goods out of these hostile zones, and his hidden skill catches the attention of elite fighters who offer him a spot at a school built to train the world's strongest.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A low ranking member of a ruthless faction is wiped out during a routine mission gone wrong.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Dying alongside his squad, he is confronted with a strange system offering him a restart, and given that second chance he vows to climb the ranks of his old organization through smarter choices.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: In a world where one group of people is kept in bondage by another, a protector of the oppressed meets a violent end at the hands of a rival power.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He wakes again inside the body of the very fighter who destroyed him, inheriting immense physical strength and a new identity, and uses this second chance to resume his fight for those without freedom.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Two women from very different circumstances share the same quiet wish to disappear from the lives they've been given.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: One rescues the other from a river after a forced marriage to a much older man, and what grows between them mixes real affection with intentions neither is ready to admit.

entries.title: Demon King of the Royal Class

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A writer dies and wakes up inside the very story he wrote, now living as one of its weaker background characters.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He ends up enrolled at an elite school under a false identity, trying to survive court politics while keeping anyone from discovering what he actually is.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: In a world where a hidden minority faces quiet discrimination, someone falls for a person who has made clear they despise that group.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She has to hide what she really is from the popular boy she's falling for, especially since he's openly hostile toward people like her.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Someone stepping into a classic villain role from old fairy tales decides to rewrite that reputation from the inside.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Taking on the role of a young girl's new mother figure inside a palace, she sets out to win the child's trust and soften a distant father, all while secrets and old schemes simmer around the family.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A woman relives her final years after a ruinous betrayal ends both her marriage and her life.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Given a second chance at a younger age, she sets out to steer her cheating husband and her former friend toward each other, using their betrayal as the perfect leash for her revenge.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A friendless teenager finds his only real connection in anonymous conversations with strangers online.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He unexpectedly matches with someone his own age who turns out to be a girl from his own class, and now has to face her in person after months of only knowing her through a screen.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: In an age defined by despair after monstrous rifts appear, nearly everyone has given up the fight except for one person who refuses to stop.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He turns out to have outlasted every other fighter who came before him, and is pulled back to where their long story first started.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A lowly servant ends up married to a nobleman who expected someone of much higher status.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She's hiding a secret far bigger than her disguise, one that could rewrite the kingdom's history, and the two of them must find a way toward trust without turning on each other.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A grieving man who lost his family in a violent tragedy is drawn into a mysterious game with much higher stakes than survival.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He seems to be the only one who can glimpse what's coming before it happens, and if he can outlast everyone else playing, he's promised a reunion with the people he lost.

entries.title: The Perks of Being an S-Class Heroine

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A young prodigy hides the fact that she doesn't belong in this world, having arrived from somewhere else entirely with memories of how badly it ends.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She knows her adopted world is fated to collapse, and her best shot at surviving that end turns out to be a strange kind of protective contract rather than brute strength.

entries.title: The Perks of Being a Villainess

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A woman who spent her first life being pushed around dies and wakes up as the wealthy, feared antagonist of a story she once knew.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Enjoying her new life of comfort and power, she discovers her character is fated to be shipped off to a convent, and now has to dodge that ending before it catches up with her.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Someone wakes up inside a game they used to play, discovering they're now a minor noble in a world with a countdown to disaster.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: To stop the coming catastrophe, he starts quietly adopting and raising the children fated to become its worst threats, even as the kingdom grows convinced he's secretly the mastermind behind a wave of crime.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After a painful rejection, a young woman falls hard for the city's most celebrated protector after he saves her life.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A new masked troublemaker starts causing chaos around the same time, and the hero begins to suspect the person behind the mask might be closer to him than he thinks.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A legendary warrior who once saved the world from ending is reborn centuries later inside the body of an ordinary teenager.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He discovers that the students he trained in his first life are now scattered across a different era, born long after he was originally gone, and sets out to track them down and guide them again.
