storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A mocked, low-tier player in a brutal survival game is written off by everyone around him as hopeless.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He's spent all his effort upgrading one cheap, unglamorous piece of gear to its absolute limit, and it turns out to hit far harder than anyone expected, catching his tormentors completely off guard.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Born without the one trait that matters most in his powerful family, a low-ranked son is branded a failure and discarded along with his mother.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Killed for that same flaw, he's reborn as a teenager who finally awakens the very gift he was denied, along with power beyond what anyone in his bloodline has seen, and sets out for revenge.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A woman forced to serve as a living weapon for a cruel throne gets a second chance at the age where her suffering first began.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She's reborn with full memory of her old life as a weapon for the crown, and instead of pursuing a gentle heir to the throne, she starts quietly steering a young prince down a far harsher path for her own ends.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After his twin is murdered right in front of him, a young man decides to take on his sibling's identity and continue his path.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The problem is he never had his twin's talent for combat, so he throws himself into secret training to catch up before the people around him start noticing the difference.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: In a world reshaped by a century of monster incursions, an orphan's dream of becoming a professional fighter is cut short by a cruel accident.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A mysterious training program invites him to spar virtually against legends from the past, and as he climbs through raids and tournaments, he starts noticing unsettling questions about his own history tied to the program itself.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A high school dropout who's good with his fists gets pulled into an unusual proposal after handling a group of troublemakers on his own.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He's given a new role at a school, tasked by a mysterious organization to enroll undercover and take down the worst troublemakers from the inside.

entries.title: A Good Day to be a Dog

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A girl carries an old family curse that transforms her into an animal the moment she has her first kiss.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The only way to reverse it is a second kiss, which becomes a serious problem since the boy she's falling for happens to be terrified of the very creature she turns into.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A man trapped in a repeating cycle of reincarnation keeps chasing the same dream of becoming unstoppable, only to lose to the same rival every single time.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: On his sixth try, he's born into a completely different, modern setting with none of the martial world he used to fight for, forcing him to figure out an entirely new purpose.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After a strange accident sends him into another world entirely, a man spends over a century mastering martial arts before finally returning home.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The world he comes back to has changed completely, now full of people who gain power by fighting monsters, and despite his old mastery he's forced to start from the very bottom again, all while hunting the person responsible for his fate.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An ordinary teenager gets pulled into another world, ends up wielding a rare kind of dark magic, and eventually earns his way back home as a hero.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: His return doesn't last long, since a monster outbreak erupts almost immediately, and he ends up drafted into mandatory service to deal with the very kind of threat he thought he'd left behind.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A prince who spent years in hiding is dragged back into palace life he wants nothing to do with.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He grows close to a quiet, devoted attendant with his own secrets and ambitions, and their bond starts to look like the spark that could set a rebellion in motion.

entries.title: My Life as an Internet Novel

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An avid reader of a certain kind of online fiction wakes up living inside a story with all its familiar, exaggerated tropes.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Surrounded by an unfairly gorgeous best friend and a handful of impossibly attractive classmates, she tries to stay a background character, but starts wondering if she's actually meant to be the one the story revolves around.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A quiet girl endures relentless bullying from a former friend who turned on her without warning.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: At night she slips into a private mental escape where a mysterious stranger offers to help her get even with the person making her days unbearable.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: The best player of a certain game finds himself pulled into a real version of the very world he mastered on screen.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Now competing against other hopefuls for a status close to divine, he has to figure out how his old in-game expertise translates into a fight where the prize is nothing less than godhood.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A middle-aged fighter falls in battle while trying to avenge his brother against an empire that crushed his homeland.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He wakes up young again, years before his family cast him out, and uses everything he remembers from his first life to quietly build weapons, gather talent, and fund a growing resistance.

entries.title: On the Way to Meet Mom

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A child found alone in an abandoned building adjusts to a new life at a shelter for kids without families.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: After watching a close friend get reunited with her own family and leave, he sets out on a journey of his own to track down the parent he's never known, gifts from a mysterious benefactor in tow.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A soldier who dies anonymously on the battlefield gets a strange second chance to grow far stronger than before.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Every new task handed to him by this mysterious system turns out to be harder than the last, leaving him racing against time to become strong enough to escape a repeat of his miserable death.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A once-feared warrior's violent life comes to an abrupt halt after a fateful clash with a holy man.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Waking up as the pampered heir of a respected family expected to pursue a quiet, studious path, he can't shake his old hunger for combat and danger.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A noblewoman hides a supernatural ability that's punishable by death if anyone in the palace finds out.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She goes undercover as a wandering spellcaster to investigate a plot against the crown, trading her skills for a promise of protection, even though exposure could cost her everything.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A magic student who understands the theory perfectly but can't actually cast anything is on the verge of washing out of his academy.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A strange, hungry creature fuses itself to his hand and starts devouring magical texts and artifacts on his behalf, making him powerful, though it might just as easily devour him if it ever runs out of other things to eat.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Reborn as a small, vulnerable creature, someone has to attach herself to someone powerful just to survive.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: After saving a member of the royal family, she's kept as a cherished pet inside the palace, only to get pulled into a dangerous rivalry between him and his brother.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Convinced he wasn't the right person for the job, a gifted spellcaster steps aside and lets someone else lead the final battle against a great evil, with disastrous results.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Given a chance to turn back time after everything falls apart, he has to reclaim the role he once refused, except this time almost no one believes the danger is real.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Someone wakes up in the body of a familiar kind of doomed side character, fully expecting to breeze through the usual playbook for surviving this kind of story.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Every trick that's supposed to work fails her, her husband seems determined to hate her no matter what she does, and something almost seems to be actively fighting to keep her stuck in her original, tragic role.

entries.title: When the Villainess is in Love

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A devoted fan wakes up inside the body of a character she used to root for from the sidelines, one who's fated to lose everything in the original story.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Instead of trying to survive quietly, she throws herself into fixing every tragic ending she remembers for the people around her, and starts to wonder if her own fate might shift as others begin seeing her differently.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A low-ranked spellcaster from a fallen noble line is cast out of his school and left to scrape by on dangerous odd jobs.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A keepsake from his mother opens a path back to his school days, and this time he awakens a new kind of power that sets him on a path to reclaiming the honor his family lost.

entries.title: Little Rabbit and the Big Bad Leopard

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A shapeshifter who can't actually shift properly is branded a failure among her own kind and left for dead.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She's rescued by a temperamental heir from a powerful predator clan, and now has to survive being surrounded by dangerous carnivorous types while stuck in a much smaller, more vulnerable form than she'd like.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After being punished socially for defending a friend, a middle schooler transfers schools hoping for a clean start.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: On her first day she discovers a mysterious note left just for her, kicking off a trail of clues that leads her to unexpected people and places while she slowly starts trusting others again.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Someone wakes up as the jealous antagonist of a story she used to read, fully aware that this version of her is doomed to die for tormenting the woman she should be protecting instead.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: With just enough time left before her fate catches up, she tries to steer the original couple toward happiness, only to complicate things after an ill-advised night ends with her waking up next to the very man she's supposed to be pushing away.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A woman who lived a hard, bloody first life is reborn as the gifted daughter of a struggling noble house.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Family debt forces her into marriage with a cursed nobleman transformed into a monstrous form, and it turns out her particular set of skills is exactly what it takes to bring him back under control, and eventually back to human shape.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A long-struggling actress finally lands a small part in a project that everyone expects to be a hit.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A much bigger celebrity keeps crossing paths with her at her lowest moments, and neither of them can quite explain why he can't stop thinking about her once they end up working together.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A boy-crazy girl invites a rival for her crush's attention over with less than friendly intentions, only for the evening to go in an unexpected direction.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The two end up becoming close friends instead, teaming up on scheme after scheme to win over the same boy, even as her feelings for her new friend start quietly outgrowing the crush that started it all.

entries.title: The First Night With the Duke

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A reader wakes up as a minor character inside her favorite romance story, planning to enjoy the perks of the setting without disturbing the actual plot.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Those plans fall apart fast after she ends up sharing a bed with the story's leading man, leaving her scrambling to keep the original couple on track while fending off a jealous rival and feelings she never expected to catch.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An ordinary office worker more worried about closing a deal gets caught in a monster outbreak and awakens with rare combat power.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: His new abilities draw eager allies and dangerous rivals into a war against threats pouring in from other dimensions.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A young cook wakes up in a land of dragons, war, and magic, and decides to keep cooking anyway.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He tries to build a quiet food business in a realm built for battle, treating recipes like another kind of craft.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After nearly dying in a monster war, a fighter wakes up decades earlier with full memory of what is coming.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Still stuck in a child's body, he races to rebuild the power he once lacked and steer his family away from the choices that once got them killed.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A novelist wakes up as a despised side character he wrote for an early death, trapped before his own story even starts.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: With almost no knowledge of this earlier timeline, he has to survive as a rude noble brat everyone already wants gone.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A hardworking student returning to campus finds her life unraveling after she gets close to a polished senior everyone admires.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She starts to wonder whether his perfect manners hide deliberate sabotage, and whether she walked into it on purpose.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A girl raised in hardship learns she is royalty, then gets a cold welcome from the family that left her behind.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Friendship with a catlike being from a rival people pulls her into a fragile peace neither side quite trusts.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A burned-out martial powerhouse reincarnates hoping for a quiet life after years of bloodshed.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Peace lasts until a child appears and asks him to play parent until graduation, dragging him back into ordinary trouble.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An orphan finds a harsh teacher who promises secret martial techniques in exchange for years of strange apprenticeship.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The training includes chores, instruments, and ego-crushing drills that seem unrelated to fighting, until the real skill finally starts to click.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A mediocre college kid who always wished he could split himself finally wakes up with a power that multiplies him.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: What starts as a shortcut for studying and play turns into something the wider power scene notices, with plans far bigger than his.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A burned-out graduate student sworn off classrooms forever is reborn into a noble family of spellcasters.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: As a spare heir he still has to enroll in an elite academy, and all he wants is the easiest path to a diploma.

entries.title: Act Like a Boss Monster, Mr. Swallow!

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: The supposed terror at the heart of an unconquerable dungeon mostly wants to sleep through every crisis.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A devoted artificial maid and a skeleton holding the last working brain cell keep the lair running while their sleepy overlord ignores his reputation.

entries.title: I Married the Male Lead's Dad

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A devoted fan wakes up inside her favorite novel while the hero is still a child she can dote on up close.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Protecting his future somehow lands her in an engagement with his father, rewriting the romance she thought she came for.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A man whose body keeps demanding food faces a life-threatening weight crisis no ordinary diet can fix.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Doctors push him into a virtual world where meals taste real without the same consequences, if he can earn every dish through hard quests.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A boy raised for imperial service never questions his path until an unlikely friendship complicates what loyalty means.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The gap in personality and family background between him and his new ally starts reshaping both of them, and the planet they serve.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An ordinary person is dropped into a deadly contest where players cooperate and murder each other for a divine prize.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: With no natural talent, he survives by crude tricks and dirty tactics that other competitors underestimate until it is too late.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A powerful fighter is betrayed by his own guild, then wakes years later in a new body stripped of everything he once had.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: New allies help him climb a familiar tower again, this time with a rare gift that lets him learn every occupation inside it.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A gamer who poured absurd hours into a popular online world suddenly receives an exclusive class built around his odd habit.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: One of his skills lets him fight while unconscious, and both rivals and developers start watching the strange rookie climb.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A rising martial prodigy set to lead the righteous side is murdered by jealous rivals before he can take power.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He wakes as the playboy second-in-command of a demonic faction and has to decide how much of his old virtue can survive on the dark side.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A legendary combat instructor is killed and wakes in a frail body teaching martial arts at a tiny countryside school.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Fixing that body costs money, so he aims for the top academy circuit and turns teaching itself into his arena.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A single father living a quiet office life snaps when his daughter vanishes and may already be dead.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: His old black-ops skills come back online as he tears through anyone standing between him and the truth.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A young man racing to save a failing orphanage stakes everything on a deadly tower few climbers ever leave.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Unexpected recordings of himself clearing that tower in the future hand him a walkthrough before he even starts.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A struggling web novelist finds a strange app that ranks him as a bottom-tier hunter and promises real power for clearing missions.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Quests and followers pile up while his serialization stalls, and the line between the game world and daily life keeps blurring.

entries.title: At The End of The Road

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After a crash, a man wakes in the body of a bullied student and refuses to stay a pushover this time.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: An old acquaintance somehow recognizes who he used to be, and a buried past between them threatens to rewrite both futures.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A meticulously organized student has every goal scheduled except a date, so she joins a club hoping attraction will follow.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Instead of the charming coworker who recruited her, she keeps colliding with his sharp-tongued friend, and her inexperience shows.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After watching her family die in staged tragedies, a woman is granted another life that begins at birth.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Trapped as an infant with adult memories, she has to crawl, talk, and uncover the conspiracy before history repeats.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: When otherworldly monsters invade, powered humans become both protectors and threats, and a student hides his own fights behind a secret identity.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The invasion story the public believes starts looking incomplete as shadowy players shape who gets to be called a hero.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: School is full of judgment and home is worse, so a girl hides in an abandoned house just to study in peace.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The town's worst delinquent starts using the same hideout to sleep, and forced coexistence slowly exposes why both avoid everyone else.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A quiet student who prefers ghosts for company stays invisible at school until the most popular girl suddenly notices him.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: That attention drags his paranormal friendships into daylight and turns a carefully low-profile life upside down.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A frail innkeeper's son dreams of martial mastery until a mysterious guest leaves behind a painting that will not leave his mind.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Skills he never trained start pouring through him, and a scatterbrained kid suddenly has a path that destiny had closed.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Years after a dimensional invasion, a boy born to two different kinds of powered parents is pushed to inherit both legacies.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Neither parent knows what the other can do, and each wants him trained in their own path while he carries both bloodlines.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A royal advocate for oppressed artificial people is about to die at their hands when her own sister poisons her instead.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Waking years earlier, she aims for the throne and recruits the future rebel leader as her personal guard before the uprising can begin.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A man who can see which paths lead to disaster starts intervening in catastrophes before they happen.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The more lives he saves while wearing a feared public face, the heavier his own unhappiness grows.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A recovering pushover wakes as a timid noble wife crushed by servants, society, and a distant husband.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She fights back through hospitality and business sense, brewing respect one carefully served cup at a time.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Abandoned with crushing debt after losing his family, a young man decides there is nothing left worth staying for.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Even that final exit proves harder than expected, trapping him in a grim comedy of failed endings and unfinished pain.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A boy content to stay in his crush's shadow suddenly finds his name whispered through every hallway at school.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A rumor brands him the campus love advisor while he still has no idea what to do about his own hopeless crush.

entries.title: After School Lessons for Unripe Apples

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An ordinary middle schooler who likes comics and karaoke has her routine broken when a boy from her past transfers in.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Every attempt to reconnect only seems to annoy him, and she cannot figure out what she did wrong.

entries.title: My Master is a Backseat Gamer

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: In a city of heroes fighting extradimensional monsters, a powerless support fighter gets an invisible tutor from another age.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Secret fist training thrusts him onto the front lines while his sharp-tongued teacher rides along, coaching every move no one else can see.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A noblewoman branded a bloody tyrant is really a scapegoat, cursed to kill the husband she loves or die herself.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Time snaps back to days before the wedding, giving her one chance to clear her name and spare the kingdom the same fate.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A daring tribal fighter is seized near forbidden mountains and discovers an entire civilization beyond the world he knew.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Freeing himself, he wanders that new realm collecting allies, enemies, and lessons that reshape what kind of warrior he becomes.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A man at rock bottom decides to end things, only to be punished for treating dying like a joke.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He is forced through a dozen borrowed lives, each racing toward a fatal end he must outrun if he wants any of them to continue.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A dungeon guide is betrayed by a client into a fatal curse and should have stayed dead.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A thinking relic brings him back for a bargain that means more raids, more monsters, and a long path toward revenge.

entries.title: The Legendary Hero is an Academy Honors Student

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: One of the figures who once saved the world from primordial evil is reborn eager to revisit old glory, then finds history forgot him.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He enrolls in a hero academy to dig up why his past was erased, and who benefits from keeping those records buried.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A girl wakes as the doomed side character meant to lose her fiancé to her sister and die hated.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She walks away from the romance plot entirely and tries to build a quiet shop around paper and pens instead of court intrigue.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Raised as the prophesied companion of a future emperor, a girl is discarded the instant another candidate appears.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Death sends her back to childhood, and this time she refuses the prophecy's chains instead of waiting to be replaced again.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A mage who served the empire is executed on false charges when a corrupt ruler takes the throne.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He wakes as a talentless baronet's son and enters a demon-haunted forest to claw his way back to the power he once held.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An embarrassing fanfic about a dethroned royal is published behind its author's back and becomes a treasonous hit.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Protection comes with a price: write a sequel that repairs his ruined image, even though the icy subject already hates her for the first book.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An orphan survives by posing as a dead noble daughter until the same household that saved her later orders her killed.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Sent back in time, she abandons the lie and follows ancient ruins and a dark knight's aid toward a fate she chooses herself.

entries.title: The Holy Power of Modern Medicine

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A gifted surgeon dies in a crash and wakes in a fantasy world determined to keep saving lives.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The magical gifts he receives seem poorly matched to medicine, forcing him to reinvent healing with the wrong toolkit.

entries.title: I Was Tricked into this Fake Marriage!

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After conquest reshapes the nobility, a new countess must marry quickly or lose her family's title and land.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She hires a shady guild to find a lower-ranked husband for show, and the man they deliver is not quite what the contract promised.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A boy wakes from a coma to find his parents gone and the rich bullies who ruined them living without consequences.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Isolating himself high above the street, he finds a burning blade and a voice urging him to stop hiding and start hunting.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A gang leader dies and wakes in the underworld with a dark bracelet locked on his wrist.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: One bracelet means a ticket downward, but collecting enough of them can be traded for a path back to life.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Two people who look angelic in public are hiding dangerous pasts from each other and their congregation.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Blackmail over a murder she did not commit flips into a lethal push-and-pull as each tries to hold power over the other.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A woman marked for execution suddenly finds her executioner acting like a lovesick fool.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The enchantment that softens him is failing, and his moods swing between devotion and the urge to kill her again.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An athlete's shot at the national team collapses when an injury hits right before tryouts.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She falls for a charming outsider tied to the wrong crowd, and the romance pulls her into danger beyond the gym.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A faded martial leader wakes in the broken body of a family disgrace with nothing left to lose.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He still carries the power of his discarded life, and sets out to prove to the martial world that strength does not stay buried.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A stressed reader wakes inside her favorite novel, but not as the heroine she expected.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Stuck as a hated minor role everyone loathes, she decides to sit back and watch the drama instead of chasing the romance route.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A struggling miner in a hunter economy inherits a relic that drops him into a lethal otherworld.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Each death there resets him stronger, and the gear he stockpiles sells for a fortune back home.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A late starter at college is determined to bury her past and blend in like any other student.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Someone who knows the secret that could ruin her shows up on campus, and gossip, jealousy, and old history refuse to stay quiet.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A princess is shipped off to marry a notorious emperor known for cruelty.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Rather than go quietly, she meets his reputation with bold demands and tries to outmatch him at his own ruthless game.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Two model students who used to be close form a cover story to escape their strict parents.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: What starts as a convenient act for freedom slowly reopens the friendship they let fall apart.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A mediocre writer wakes inside a martial arts epic as its most hated antagonist.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: To dodge a gruesome scripted death, she has to learn real combat, pick allies carefully, and keep a clan from collapsing.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Nightmares of a woman promising to wait have haunted him since a childhood massacre.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Moving to a notorious haunted street nearly kills him, until a stranger who matches the dream pulls him into a war among demons.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Two teens who hate home and each other are forced into the same abandoned building.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Sharing a ruined dorm becomes a slow, ugly education in growing up when neither wants to be the adult.

entries.title: What It Takes to Be a Villainess

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Heartbroken and drowning, she wakes as the hated daughter of a powerful house.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Named a candidate for empress, she has to play colder and sharper than the palace schemers, or her new family pays the price.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A soldier trained as a weapon is discarded in her final moments, then opens her eyes on a different war.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Stripped of the emotions that once made her human, she has to decide whether this new battlefield will use her the same way.

entries.title: A Tender Heart: The Story of How I Became a Duke's Maid

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A cursed noble doomed to loneliness in a novel suddenly gains an unexpected ally from outside the story.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A reader drops in as his lowly maid and sets out to rewrite the misery written for him, including a shot at real love.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A doctor of traditional medicine wakes in the frail body of a crown prince nobody expects to last.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Armed with healing knowledge this empire has never seen, he tries to mend both his failing body and a sick court.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A struggling VR player loses his account in a freak accident and is forced to start over from scratch.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: On the new character he can see hidden game data others miss, and that edge pushes him toward a rare class and a sudden rise.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A hero who was taught never to kill breaks that vow after his squad and his brother are destroyed.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He takes a license to end lives inside a prison for villains, hunting the one responsible through its worst inmates.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A notorious escape artist is moved to the world's harshest prison under a war hero's watch.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The guard starts to doubt the murder charge that put her there, and the truth behind the case becomes as dangerous as the walls.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: When monsters overrun the city, a young man finds he can control his entire apartment building from inside one unit.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The catch is he cannot step outside, so he has to arm neighbors and lead them into the ruined streets without ever leaving home.

entries.title: From a Knight to a Lady

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A fallen warrior wakes years later in the spoiled body of a count's daughter in the empire that conquered her homeland.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She is betrothed to a man who was her enemy in her first life, and she has to survive court while digging into how she died.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A baby royal is adored by the court, but her family is the kind that could burn an empire down.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She still remembers a past life as a powerful mage, and must steer assassin plots and war-hungry kin without giving that knowledge away.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A fencing prodigy wakes as a doomed side character in a novel and has to keep her family alive by any cover available.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: When her twin flees conscription, she enlists under his name, only for a dangerous prince to notice her sword work and claim her as his own.

entries.title: The Siren: Becoming the Villain's Family

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A captive whose voice bewitches nobles dies after years of forced performances, then wakes earlier in the same life.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Freed too late by a feared duke, she dedicates her second chance to protecting him, while wondering if she will ever stop being used for her song.

entries.title: Destined To Be Loved by the Villains

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After a night of gaming, he wakes as an unimpressive side character in the school setting of that game.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Trying to stay invisible only pulls him toward the final boss, the hero, and a string of dangerous figures who will not leave him alone.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A broke student accepts help from a stranger who wants something permanent in return.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He is a mid-level demon on a corporate deadline, so she ends up working his coffee shop while he tries to talk her into selling her soul.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Two school friends, one a striker and one a grappler, keep campus bullies in check until one fight goes too far.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: What looked like a schoolyard brawl sends him into the streets hunting for the truth behind that day.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A woman who lived someone else's royal happily-ever-after is betrayed the moment the real face of that role returns.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Sent back to the start of the story, she stops playing the starring victim and starts arranging the downfall of everyone who used her.

entries.title: A Dance of Swords in the Night

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Taken as a child and trained in poison, he finally returns home seeking the fighters who raised him.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He finds their school crushed by a rival sect and turns the reunion into a hunt for survivors, willing to poison anyone in the way.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After dying from overwork, she wakes as a novel antagonist and only wants a quiet life off the main plot.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A hatchling meant for the heroine bonds with her instead, and that accidental bond drags her straight into the story she hoped to avoid.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: The school's golden boy and its least popular student keep ending up in each other's orbit.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Neither of them can explain the pull, and the more they try to ignore it, the messier everything between them gets.

entries.title: Charming the Duke of the North

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A famous actress wakes after a set accident in a fantasy kingdom and is saved by a cold northern lord.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He asks her to play his lover so she can slip into high society and uncover a conspiracy inside his castle.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An overworked temp spends one disastrous day as a famous actor's assistant and snaps in private.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The doll she vents on can actually control him, and suddenly the power balance between them flips.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Sold off as a child, a girl is dropped into the household of the empire's most feared duke.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She has to learn what her new bloodline means, and survive the enemies who will come for her once they learn she exists.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A returning student finds a bargain place to live and meets an intruder on his first night.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The stranger ignores the valuables and obsesses over his unfinished stories, then offers to keep house so he can write more.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A model student is thrown from a rooftop and spends years trapped awake inside a body that will not move.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He suddenly returns to the day the bullying started, with a decade of helpless memory and a chance to change how it ends.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Dropped into her favorite novel as a wealthy duchess, she inherits a child destined to become a monster.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He is still small and soft for now, but his father wants him dead, and raising him safely means rewriting a tragedy already on the page.

entries.title: What a Bountiful Harvest, Demon Lord!

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A stressed agriculture student wakes inside his fantasy game as the final boss everyone fears.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Instead of ruling through terror, he tries to win loyalty the only way he knows: by feeding an army that marches on its stomach.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A bullied student ready to end it all is shoved off a roof by an upperclassman and somehow wakes unharmed.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: That same senior is a top fighter in a hidden martial world, and asking him for training pulls the boy into far uglier fights than school.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A trusting fiancée wrecks her body for the man she loves, then catches him with her cousin and dies for the betrayal.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Sent a year into the past, she stops sacrificing herself and considers an alliance with a coldhearted duke instead.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A creator designed a frail body traded for extreme magic, then wakes up trapped inside that design.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A mysterious drug lets him finally wield that power at full strength, but walking the line between cure and ruin becomes the real fight.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An aging martial alliance leader dies confused by his own fading legacy and wakes as a clan heir known for wasting his life.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Playing the opposite of his old stern self, he starts fixing the mess he inherited while digging into what really killed him.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A job hunter dies saving a drowning child and is offered another life by a goddess.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Instead of a hero's body, he starts as a weak, skill-less larva and has to claw his way up from the bottom of a dungeon world.

entries.title: Necromancer Academy and the Genius Summoner

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A boy with terrifying latent talent is scouted by a school that trains people who can drop empires.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Inside those halls his gifts grow fast, and that kind of promise starts attracting consequences he never asked for.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A legendary mage who saved the world dies still missing the one thing her heart wanted.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Reborn under a new face, she hides from the students she once taught while hunting for the love that eluded her first life.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Born with once-in-a-generation martial talent, he is also cursed to die before adulthood.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Stuck in a third-rate clan with little time left, he races to turn raw gift into a future that outruns the sentence on his life.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A legendary hunter dies at the peak and wakes as the delinquent heir of a powerful company in another era.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Relatives hungry for power force him to rebuild from level one, mixing the death arts he knew with martial skills this world understands.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Decades after a great war, the martial world has sunk into petty crime and faded glory.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A young swordsman sets out to restore old codes of justice, betting loyalty can still beat corruption and greed.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Somewhere between living and the end, ordinary people brush against what waits on the other side.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Short encounters at that border ask who stands there, and what it means to cross or turn back.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A sheltered daughter living in her siblings' shadow learns she has only a year left, and makes a desperate bargain to spend it on her own terms.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She proposes a deal to her fiancé that would take them far from her controlling family, and the arrangement unexpectedly reshapes both of them.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A hopeless romantic's engagement collapses when her rival steals the man she thought was hers.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A storybook romance she turns to for comfort starts playing out in real life, with her nemesis cast as the heroine and the same prize waiting for whoever claims him first.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A thirty-something freeloader desperate for money makes a shady deal that costs far more than cash.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The bargain opens a path into another world meant for the weak and overlooked, where changing your lot means serving something that may not be human.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: One of the last humans left standing in a god's cruel arena game gets a second chance to undo the slaughter.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He arrives decades earlier with school friends and old enemies still around, racing to relearn skills and break the game before history repeats.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An orphaned boy raised by a mistreated couple inherits their burdens and two younger siblings to protect.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: In a land where the lowest caste has almost no rights, the only path he sees out is graduating from an elite academy, the same route a former underclasser once used to become emperor.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Dropped into a beloved story as a minor character, she plans to watch the happy ending from the sidelines.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: When the finale instead kills the person she cared about most, time resets to that day and she decides to stop spectating and rewrite their fate.

entries.title: The Dragon Slayer's Regression on Another Level

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Cast out for failing a rite every heir was expected to pass, a disgraced fighter claws his way to a feared reputation before dying on a mission.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He wakes years younger inside his family's brutal training ground, determined to seize the power he was denied and rewrite how his story ends.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: In a world of dimensional gates, the chosen few who fight monsters eventually crown themselves rulers over everyone else.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A powerless ordinary person training to join them is shoved a century into the past with one job: stop that future order from ever taking root.

entries.title: I Stole the First Ranker’s Soul

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An ordinary office worker wakes inside a dungeon and barely scrapes out with a new hunter identity.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Rescued by the world's top fighter, she becomes bound to him under one impossible condition: help wipe out every dungeon boss that exists.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: When portals upend ordinary life, a struggling provider finally awakens with a power that looks useless on paper.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He cannot grow the usual way, so he leans on interdimensional trade, swapping goods for the stats and gear that let him clear dungeons anyway.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Humanity scrapes through a war against winged invaders thanks to people born with strange powers.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A prophecy says the enemy will return within years, so children with gifts are drilled in a special facility for a final clash almost no one is ready for.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A high schooler worn down by relentless bullying decides to stop enduring and strike back.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The revenge works, but quitting school for a life among runaways drops him into street turf wars far meaner than classroom cruelty.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A lifelong pushover wakes up as the antagonist she wrote into a novel a decade ago.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Trapped in a day that resets until she plays the role properly, she accepts help from a mysterious warlock who offers to teach her how to be wicked.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A romance fan reincarnates as a princess and sets her sights on the character she always rooted for.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He is a banished former prince whose original ending went badly, and she wants their second chance at life to become a second chance at love.

entries.title: Touch My Little Brother and You're Dead

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: She wakes as an older sister in a novel she knows, content to stay off the main stage until she learns a loved one's fate.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Every time that sibling dies young, her life rewinds to age sixteen, and after enough resets she decides anyone who endangers him is fair game.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A proud martial hierarch is cursed into a strange fantasy realm of elves, mages, and knights.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: When his mana talent draws the wrong attention, a second curse forces him into a young woman's body while he still tries to fight his way home.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A hidden royal disguises herself as household staff in the empire that conquered her homeland.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A wish for the power to help others fills her dreams with other people's brilliance, and she wakes with whatever skills the moment needs, even as a prince hunts both of her identities.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A soldier dies defending his homeland and opens his eyes inside the body of the other side's royalty.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Vengeance means surviving palace intrigue, an abusive half-brother, and a mother's deadly schemes while wearing the face of his sworn foe.

entries.title: I Woke Up as the Villain

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An ordinary desk worker reincarnates as a hated rich heir fated to be used and killed.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He claws toward survival by awakening supernatural power, leveling through monster-filled dimensions while outmaneuvering the people who want him gone.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A student raised to obsess over grades hits college and suddenly faces pressure she was never taught to handle.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A chance meeting with a gifted artist pulls her into a televised beauty contest that forces her to rethink what appearance means in society.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Humanity's hope rests on a mysterious tower that offers different difficulty paths to grow stronger.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: After conquering it the soft way and still finding himself too weak to stop the end of the world, he rewinds and commits to the harshest path for a real second chance.

entries.title: How to Hide the Emperor’s Child

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After a brief, discarded marriage to a ruler, a former wife builds a quiet life far from court with a secret she cannot risk exposing.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Years later imperial guards arrive needing her consent for a key territory deal, and keeping a child's true parentage hidden becomes suddenly impossible.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: In a world ranked by strange gifts, a feared low-ranker can take power from the dead even as his presence brings bad luck to others.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: After his entire group is wiped out, he returns to earlier days desperate to rewrite that massacre, only to learn those gifts are not as fixed as everyone believed.

entries.title: I Failed to Oust the Villain!

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Reborn as a count's daughter, she recognizes the story's coming tragedy and tries to remove the threat living under her roof.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: When that threat's magic awakens and everyone around her dies, she survives only because he cannot let her go, trapped under his protection.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A young woman keeps turning down the dates her mother pays matchmakers to arrange.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: An old school friend suddenly proposes marriage, and she has to decide whether the offer is a way out of money trouble or a trap in nicer clothes.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A successful fantasy author is dragged into her own series by the worst character she ever created.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He demands she use her authorship to hand him the throne, and she has to rewrite both their fates before the original plot destroys them.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A scholar who failed the national exams is taken in by a martial master with one odd job: write his life into a book.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Traveling beside him, the failed examinee meets legends and slowly steps onto the same path toward becoming a martial powerhouse himself.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A spirited noblewoman realizes she is the villain of a romance novel and that her beloved younger sister is doomed by the plot.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She marries the man meant for that sister to rewrite the ending, knowing he is supposed to fall for the real heroine later.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: On her sixteenth birthday, a girl loses everyone she knows and is pulled into a journey across a dangerous world.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Traveling with a powerful magician through realms of gods, monsters, and bloodline politics, she hunts the truth of her past while carrying a power that could reshape everything.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Two royal children grow up neglected in a rundown castle under a cruel household instead of the palace they were born for.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: After a sudden accident removes their guardian, their absent father reappears and demands they join court, forcing them to survive a world of royals who never protected them.

entries.title: The Dungeon Cleaning Life of a Once Genius Hunter

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A once-legendary hunter is shoved a decade into the past after an ambush, only to find his old powers locked away.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The only way to unlock them again is taking a low-status maintenance role inside cleared gates, and he approaches that work with the same ruthless drive he once used to fight.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: When monsters prepare to invade and nearly everyone is whisked away to train elsewhere, one overlooked student is left behind.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: After centuries alone fighting with divine helpers who finally notice him, the evacuated population returns to find a world shaped by the person they never saw.

entries.title: Like Wind on a Dry Branch

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: In an empire wracked by plague, a widow loses almost everything and ends up at the mercy of a cruel noble's dying wish.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She is nearly sealed alive beside a corpse until an unexpected visit from the realm's outcast prince interrupts the sentence and changes her fate.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: On her deathbed, a noble wife regrets pouring her life into a loveless marriage that kept a rough husband's lands afloat.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Waking a decade earlier, she tries to refuse that exhausting duty and live for herself, if she can find the courage to defy him.

entries.title: The Little Princess and Her Monster Prince

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A reader drops into a trashy old romance as the child bride of a cursed royal everyone is meant to fear.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Instead of fleeing his marked body as the plot demands, she stays long enough to rebuild his confidence before the story's supposed true heroine arrives.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A hardworking child in the slums uses imagination to escape a harsh home and a neglectful parent.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: After a vision of disaster, that parent suddenly arranges a marriage into the imperial family, and the child must learn to live in a reality that finally matches her wildest daydreams.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A legendary competitive player drops into a cutting-edge virtual world built by megacorps.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Inside the capsule fantasy, his chaotic playstyle turns every quest and encounter into something far messier than the designers intended.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A normal graduate student wakes inside a fantasy she drafted as a teenager, wearing the identity of someone doomed to die.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Using insider knowledge, she races to settle debts, survive a deadly trial by fire, and earn trust from the story's hero before her past sins catch up.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After dungeons rewrite the world, a would-be hero is crushed to learn his own powers look worthless.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A strange gift lets him pull information from the future and legendary help from the past, turning a game of chance into his path toward the top.

entries.title: I Fell into a Reverse Harem Game!

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: She wakes as an imperial princess surrounded by suitors, only to realize she is the villain of someone else's romance game.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The manipulative maid aiming for her men is the real player, and seeing those hidden system alerts may be the only edge that lets her fight back.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Reborn as a doomed romance antagonist, she skips the tragedy by leaving court for a quiet life in the cold countryside.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Calling a powerful mage to warm her home with unnatural fire binds her to a lifelong contract with a bloodthirsty demonic companion she never meant to keep.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Two coworkers sit inches apart at work while living completely different office lives: one invisible, one everywhere.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: When the quieter one accidentally sees something private on the other's laptop, both get dragged into messy workplace dynamics neither planned for.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Years after her own reincarnation, a young woman hears that another dimensional traveler has arrived at court and cannot resist investigating.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A handsome duke proposes a fake engagement to keep a gold-digging newcomer away, and the arrangement starts blurring into something real.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After magic-wielding enemies declare war on humanity, specialist fighters are trained to hunt them down.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: One of the best marksmen on that frontline still cannot bring himself to hate the people he is ordered to destroy, even as the battles keep coming.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A man who remembers dying wakes beside a sister he thought was gone and assumes he has reached the afterlife.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Instead he is in an alternate timeline where relatives bankrupted his family during his long coma, and he means to use old skills to put them back on top.

entries.title: The Tyrant Wants to Be Good

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A ruler who seized love and power by the sword accepts her execution, then wakes years younger with a second chance.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Determined not to repeat the bloodshed that defined her, she tries to choose kindness in a childhood that once taught her only how to take.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A top student at an all-girls school lies about having a boyfriend and gets cornered into an impossible bargain.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She must tutor a delinquent into college while that same girl finds her a date, and the arrangement starts shifting into feelings she did not plan for.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A young man's dreams keep starring the same clever beauty, who insists something happened between them that he cannot recall.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Hints from waking life slowly restore the missing memory, and recovering it forces him to face how their relationship might change.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A boy wakes inside a building full of corpses and finds the city outside drowned in unnatural dark.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: No power, no traffic, no stars: the whole metropolis looks emptied, and he has to wonder whether anyone else is left alive.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After saving the realm and the princess, a legendary fighter expects glory and a new chapter.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Instead he gets unemployment and mediocrity, discovering that defeating the great enemy does not prepare you for ordinary life.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A teenage girl cannot stop replaying one impulsive kiss with her closest friend, and the silence afterward only makes it worse.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: What started as curiosity turns into a push-and-pull where each of them keeps switching who is chasing and who is running.

entries.title: The World's Strongest Are Obsessed With Me

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A young girl remembers a past life and realizes she was born next to the catastrophe at the center of a romance game.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She plans to flee before her family's ruin arrives, then finds herself drawing the attention of dangerous suitors destined to lose their minds.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A struggling digital resident scrapes by to care for his sister until a routine purge erases everything he knows.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A rare glitch leaves him with godlike editing power over the world itself, and he turns it toward revenge against the unseen hands that run it.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A conquered princess survives only by burying her true name and living as a slave in the empire that took everything.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The conqueror who ruined her homeland notices her wit and charm, pulling her into a dangerous game of attraction and hidden identity.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: In a ruthless noble house that eats its own children, a cold heir is meant to become the story's greatest monster.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: His little sister is actually a reader reborn into the plot, determined to stay close and rewrite the deadly fate waiting for her.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A popular schoolgirl draws endless attention from other girls while quietly terrified of men and smothered by an overprotective home.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The campus beauty confesses and then refuses to share her, following her so closely that friendship starts looking like possession.

entries.title: A Wicked Tale of Cinderella's Stepmom

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Someone wakes up inside a famous fairy tale, cast as the dreaded older woman everyone already hates.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Twice widowed with three daughters to settle, she aims for soft endings for all of them while a charming young noble keeps circling her instead.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A cruel princess pays for one public humiliation with her life and, dying, calls something inhuman for payback.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The being who answers is a novice eager for her first human pact, and the revenge requested may outmatch what a beginner can deliver.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A wealthy loner at school answers bullying with a temper fierce enough to make her infamous.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Her family secretly pays a transfer student a fortune to guard her while hiding who hired him and why he showed up.

entries.title: The Genius Assassin Who Takes It All

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A writer wakes inside his own fantasy as the disposable villain, stuck at the bottom of a lethal hierarchy.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Armed with author knowledge he never meant to need, he has to twist the ending, beat the true threat, and claw a path back to reality.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After dying in a world of dungeons and awakened fighters, a man is offered a second run through the same timeline.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He returns early with a ruthless plan: get rich enough to buy the land where disaster will open and crush it before monsters spill out.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Cursed to live life after life in every role imaginable, she finally wants nothing more than idle peace.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Reborn as a grand duke's daughter with a fiancé and a demanding household, she keeps fleeing duty only to find the world will not let her nap.

entries.title: My 990 Thousand Past Lives Help Me

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A bottom-tier hunter keeps failing raids, losing respect, and watching even his relationship collapse under the gap in rank.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Drunk and broken, he stumbles into a dreamscape where earlier selves offer power through brutal trials he has to endure one by one.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A young woman carries a hollow gap where two crucial years of her life should be, and everyday catching up never fills it.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: While caring for stray cats, she meets a boy who somehow seems to hold the exact stretch of time she lost.

entries.title: Tricked into Becoming the Heroine's Stepmother

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After dying, a woman wakes as a poor commoner inside a tragedy novel she recognizes all too well.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: As the original author, she inserts herself beside the doomed heroine and her powerful father, determined to steer them off the bitter ending she wrote.

entries.title: The Rebirth of a Tyrannical Empress

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A reader wakes as a hated ruler whose bloody downfall is only days away.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She races to undo the coup by showing mercy to exiles her predecessor wronged, even as the sudden softness makes rebels more suspicious.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: In a town that brands anyone too strange as dangerous, an outcast boy and a gifted outsider find each other across that fear.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She can slip through time and dimensions chasing love, and together they need more than spells to survive the twists fate keeps throwing.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: In a harsh desert between two continents, a tribal boy discovers a mysterious stranger and brings him home.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The guest turns out to be a peerless fighter who begins drilling the boy in combat until the tribe's future starts to shift.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A ruthless noble who terrifies criminals softens overnight when a chance encounter leaves him with a new daughter.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The girl carries sharp wits and memories from another life, helping the household hunt injustice until a buried mastermind resurfaces.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A quiet, composed high schooler sits in custody accused of a horrifying string of stabbings, and almost no one believes the picture fits.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Whispers turn toward his intense attachment to an older brother, and whether that devotion could explain a crime that still does not make sense.

entries.title: I'm the Queen in This Life

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A court conspirator helps seize a throne, then dies betrayed by the allies she trusted most.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Sent back to her teenage years, she uses hard-earned political cunning to rewrite palace intrigue before the same tragedy can land again.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An orphan grows up hated by the people around him, clinging to the few who still care.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: When even those last bonds are torn away, he chooses a path of revenge that will cost him everything he has left.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: When a floating stronghold appears and people everywhere awaken with powers, one ordinary guy is left completely behind.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Saving a gifted healer binds her to him as a personal support, giving him a crooked door into the powered life he was shut out of.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After years of grinding battles in a nightmare realm, a fighter finally earns a ticket home.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Earth greets him with gates spilling monsters, forcing him to put every hard-won skill to work in a second catastrophe.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A socially awkward job-seeker fails yet another attempt at a quiet government career he has chased for years.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: After a mountain attack, a secret agency drafts him to fight dust-borne man-eaters that seem strangely drawn to him as the end of the world nears.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A princess loses family, throne, and trust to a traitorous engagement, then wakes years younger with one last chance.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Her plan is to mold a useless sibling into a real ruler by out-bratting him, while swapping her fiancé for a dazzling new ally.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A notorious spendthrift ruins her house and takes a bounty job to dig it out of debt.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Finding a missing noble child lands her under a wary duke's roof for a month that stretches into a year-long contract marriage.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A quiet student knows every detail of the girl he loves, yet cannot bring himself to speak to her.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He watches from a distance day after day, willing to cross any line if it means keeping her safe and close.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A neglected girl dreams of waking as a beloved heroine, then opens her eyes as a disposable side character about to be cast out.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Her escape plan collapses when a volatile family heir claims her as his daughter and drags her into a war among the story's worst players.

entries.title: Your Majesty, Please Spare Me This Time

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After an emperor wipes out her house and she dies with it, a girl wakes in her childhood body with one survival plan.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She races to the capital to serve a disguised future tyrant still living as a princess, hoping favor will spare her family this time.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: In a world that cheers monster hunters, an outcast with strange looks learns he is dying just as disaster hits his neighborhood.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: His sister's sacrifice lets him survive and awaken a rare toxic gift that heals through poison, if he can live with what that power costs.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A numb college student drifts through classes, empty drinks, and a guitar club on life support.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: An eager freshman rubs him the wrong way at first, then slowly thaws that indifference once they start making music together.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A overworked modern clerk dies in a hit-and-run and opens his eyes as the spare son of a collapsing martial household.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Buried in debt with no real power left, he leans on bureaucratic know-how and asks to inherit the clan so he can rebuild it from the ground up.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An illegitimate royal with weak healing gifts seems doomed to a hard life on the margins of court.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Unexpected knowledge of modern medicine lets him treat what magic cannot, if he can survive the prejudice against his methods.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A girl mocked for having no magic finally meets the father who was forced to leave her behind: the realm's greatest mage.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Welcomed into a household of unusual companions, she still faces dark secrets from his past that threaten to catch them both.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Living in a gifted sibling's shadow ends when that sibling dies in battle and a hidden dragon lord rewrites the timeline.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Sent to a past where the genius never existed, he takes that empty place at school, dazzling classmates with borrowed reputation and hard-won knowledge.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: In a country obsessed with combat sports, a total weakling is dropped into a high school packed with elite martial talents.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He leans on ground-fighting technique to offset raw strength, climbing ranked fight classes one match at a time.

entries.title: What It Means to Be You

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A princess marries for duty, then watches her family's fall turn her into an outcast even inside her own marriage.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Years of misery end in a desperate act that swaps her into her husband's body, forcing both to live the life they never understood.

entries.title: I Thought My Time Was Up!

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A young woman leaves a clinic with a rare diagnosis and only a few months left, then races through a bucket list.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The fatal verdict turns out to be wrong, leaving her stuck with a remade life and the question of whether to keep the bold new version.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A decent modern doctor is ruined and murdered for trying to do the right thing, then offered another chance for all the good he did.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He returns as a legendary physician in a war-torn ancient age, forced to operate without modern tools in a world of heroes and chaos.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A daring nature streamer famous for handling venomous creatures dies on camera and wakes in a martial world full of living toxins.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Peaceful farming with poisonous specimens ends when a clan of poison masters notices his talent and decides he belongs with them.

entries.title: Reincarnation of the Hero Party's Grand Mage

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A prodigy mage joins a warrior's party to fight a spreading void, then falls to its poison on the eve of the final battle.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: An immortality spell freezes him for centuries until he returns in a noble child's body, still bound to the promise that he would come back.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A webcomic artist lands a dream romance serial just as her girlfriend dumps her, leaving the assignment painfully empty.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She hunts for fresh inspiration next door, where a neighbor flips between friendly and weirdly distant in ways she cannot ignore.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Dropped into her favorite love story, a woman learns that happy endings are harder to reach the second time around.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She starts by seeking the gentle noble she spent years writing letters to, hoping a second life will not repeat her old mistakes.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After a lifetime of bad luck, a woman wakes as a wealthy villainess and wants nothing but comfort and no drama.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The story's heroine keeps picking fights, stealing outfits, and poaching fiancés, dragging four suitors into chaos the new villainess never asked for.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Monsters pour from fractures in the world, and hunters become the most envied workers alive while a restaurant laborer just scrapes by.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A button appears before him that fights on autopilot with perfect technique, turning daily grind into effortless monster clearing.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: When towers fill the skies and monsters nearly end humanity, gifted fighters rise to hold the line.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: One of the most celebrated among them keeps saving the planet, then shrugs on camera that the paycheck is the real motivation.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A boy seems locked onto a tragic path that ends with him becoming the kind of villain stories punish.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A stranger who has dreamed his future for years arrives with a promise to untangle that fate before it swallows them both.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Humanity's last great savior dies after a lifetime of war, then opens his eyes far earlier than expected.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The restart drops him into military barracks, where a strange appetite for metal lets him grow fast enough to chase revenge.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Abandoned after a trusted relative's scam, a young woman suddenly has to live alone while her parents chase the thief.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The same con hit a powerful local cult, and the leader's son shows up at her door with luggage, ready to move in until the debt is settled.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After a scandal, a troubled student tries to keep his head down until graduation.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A model classmate keeps pushing friendship on him while someone from his violent past shows up tattooed and impossible to ignore.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An orphaned boy lives quietly in a secluded forest until a war-worn traveler pulls him into a wider journey.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Their path cuts through a land of living weapons, vengeful beasts, and godlike forces fighting over the balance of nature.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A talentless youngest son of a famous sword house is cast aside and killed for failing to measure up.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He wakes with a cursed blade and a single aim: bring down the household that discarded him.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Two people destroy each other through obsession, then one of them gets the same life over again.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She remembers how their hunger for each other ended in blood, and wonders whether warmth can replace the demand for control this time.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A psychologist who splits his days between lectures and a bar treats every mind as a puzzle built on the same rules.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: His belief that people are fundamentally alike becomes the tool he uses to untangle cases that look unique on the surface.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Trapped inside a romance plot, a woman keeps dying no matter how the story ends and waking at the same age again.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: After more than a century of resets, she stops chasing the happy ending and starts hunting everyone who ruined her.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: The childhood friend next door has always felt ordinary until a hidden nature slips into view.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Romance gets complicated once she learns he turns into something with fangs when the moon is wrong.

entries.title: I Tamed My Ex-husband’s Mad Dog

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A wronged noble wakes years earlier at a funeral and immediately turns on the royal husband who ruined her.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: On the road to exile she claims a feared war hero once loyal to him, renaming him as her weapon for revenge.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A young man built for violence only wants a gentle craft, but his father keeps pushing him toward the ring.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He ducks into a virtual reality world to chase the quiet life he wants, while real-world pressure follows him anyway.

entries.title: The Duke's Bored Daughter is My Master

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After clawing from the streets to an imperial throne and dying content, a woman wakes up alive again and wants nothing to do with ambition.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: This time she plans to coast as a pampered noble's idle charge, trading hard-won power for deliberate laziness.

entries.title: The Lady I Served Became a Master

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Dropped into her favorite novel as a maid, she vows to shepherd the mistreated heroine through the darkest stretch of the plot.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The heroine ignores every romance candidate, dabbling in dark magic instead, until a stranger who looks uncannily like her appears at the door.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A newborn royal becomes the obsession of a conqueror feared across continents: her own father.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Surviving childhood means reading the moods of a man who toppled empires and still might see her as either treasure or threat.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A guy stuck with a terrible reputation meets a mentor who promises to remake how he moves through the dating scene.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: What follows is a brash education in charm, confidence, and the messy games men play to get attention.

entries.title: The Little Lady Behind the Scenes

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A younger sibling works overtime to stop her gifted sister from falling for the wrong men.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Suitors quickly learn the path to approval runs through the little one's sweet tooth, turning courtship into a sugar-fueled contest.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A former competition prodigy loses his path to injury and a dull job that never fits.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He reinvents himself streaming a game where his aim still shines, chasing fame online while wondering if it can fix anything offline.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A battle-scarred savior of humanity dies swearing he will never fight again, then wakes as a child in a house famous for blades.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: When danger threatens the people around him, he has to choose between the quiet life he wanted and the skill he cannot quite bury.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An orphan pulled into a venomous household only understands the trap at her father's funeral.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Waking as a little girl again, she spends her second chance trying to save the parent she never truly knew.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After years of training for power, he quits and goes home to tend the family fields instead.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A being who can grow anything, even produce that boosts human strength, shows up and turns the homestead into something far stranger than crops.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An orphan raised by relatives learns too late that inheritance and affection were never the plan.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: On a second life she partners with a feared ruler for leverage, chasing revenge while suitors keep getting in the way.

entries.title: The Heavenly Demon Wants a Quiet Life

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A lifetime of bloodshed ends with a wish for peace, and he wakes frail inside a wealthy merchant household.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Old martial knowledge keeps him alive amid temptation and corruption, but growing notoriety keeps dragging violence back to his door.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A farmer's son can hear thoughts and memories, and the village answers that gift with fear.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: On the night he comes of age he finally flees, hoping strangers and animals on the road will treat him kinder than home did.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After a night of drinking, an aspiring civil servant wakes years earlier in someone else's young body with a lethal deadline attached.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He scrapes onto a televised idol survival show where raw skill is low, competition is brutal, and failure is not an option.

entries.title: My Very Own Tower Strategy Guide

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An office worker learns the world ends in two weeks after a strange medicine from a creature he rescued starts talking to him.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: When everyone is shoved into climbing teams, his edge is a walkthrough of the coming disaster and easier growth than the rest get.

entries.title: I'm a Part-Timer for the Gods
