storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: When dungeons and gifted fighters appear, one man gets nothing and hates the unfairness enough to curse the heavens.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Lightning answers him, and a system window announces that divine employers have work waiting if he will take it.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Taken from the slums as a child, she is forced to live as the son of a noble house while hiding who she really is.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Years of lies never erase the girl she remembers, and reclaiming that life becomes the only fight that matters.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A princess finds a mysterious book whose events start matching reality, including a doomed double who shares her name.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Convinced she is the imposter the plot will execute, she races to break the remaining pages before fate catches up.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Facing his mother's death, a son trades years of his own life so she can live again.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She wakes as a young college student while he spends what time he has left making her happy, until a friend falls for her.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A wild girl with unusual eyes and a tiny dragon is found in a ruined palace and claimed as long-lost royalty.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: An emperor and his other children try to draw her into the family while wondering whether her sight of hidden things will bless or break the realm.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: At the peak of a cutthroat company, a lonely executive drinks and wishes he could undo the past.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He wakes decades younger at the start of his career, armed with future knowledge and determined to fix toxic culture and broken relationships.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: At school, a disabled student is treated as a target by classmates and teachers alike.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A quiet transfer student refuses to leave his side, forcing him to decide whether trust is worth the risk.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Chaos among self-proclaimed chosen heroes has lasted for decades, and one disciple with many masters inherits the burden of fixing it.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He swears to cut through heaven's favorites, but first he has to deal with a body that is nowhere near as sharp as his resolve.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A busy career woman with a new home and a mountain of chores swears she does not need a man complicating things.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: A desperate stranger offers housework for a place to stay, claiming he is no romantic threat, until feelings and that lie start colliding.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Returning a lost wallet starts a charged connection between a student and a beautiful stranger.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She turns out to be his future homeroom teacher, and both of them have a warped sense of justice that makes the classroom dangerous.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A shy boy with a delicate face is constantly mistaken for a girl and never manages to speak to his crush.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Sharing a classroom with the most popular student only deepens the gap between wanting closeness and being too timid to ask for it.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A loyal worker is murdered by the conglomerate he served, then wakes years earlier inside the founder's bloodline.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He uses future knowledge to settle scores and aim a hostile takeover at the empire that discarded him.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A young fighter rises through a ruthless martial sect until elite assassin work still is not enough.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Decades of sword and inner energy training push him toward a legendary realm few in his order have ever reached.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A drunk blurt of affection lands on the wrong man and ruins a transplanted woman's plan for a quiet fantasy life.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Caught between healing duties in a wartime court and two compelling knights, she has to untangle feelings she never meant to start.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After winning a long war, a commander expects gold and instead is ordered to pick a noble husband from a list.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She chooses a disgraced imperial son figuring he will buy his way out, but he accepts the marriage and offers help rebuilding her ruined house for reasons of his own.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: On the eve of a wedding meant to escape her tormentors, a girl is flung back into the childhood she hoped to forget.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: What starts as payback against the household's three sons slowly turns into understanding the pain on both sides.

entries.title: The Red Knight Seeks No Reward

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A bounty-chasing fighter dies for greed and wakes years earlier determined to become a knight worth the title.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: She joins an honorable order known for its crimson colors, hoping discipline can scrub out the wrongs of the life she already lived.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A martial ruler who fought with bare hands falls to demonic rivals and wakes in a wild merchant heir's body.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Past-life technique plus new family wealth become tools for getting strong enough to settle every unpaid debt of blood.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: A veteran's last obstacle course goes lethal after a fall, and a goddess offers him a heroic second life he never asked for.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Dumped into survival with divine schemes still running, he crosses paths with another goddess, a spy, and someone from his old unit.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Dropped into another world as a despised noble daughter, she leans on the cooking craft that once saved her.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Fine-tuned taste and kitchen skill become her path to status in a society that crowns culinary excellence as real power.

entries.title: The Dang Clan’s Swordmaster Heir Just Wants a Normal Life

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: An outcast boy in a fading house of poisons and hidden weapons suddenly remembers a past life spent mastering the blade.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He wants an ordinary existence, but protecting what remains of his family keeps pulling him back into the martial world.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Dropped into a cultivator's world with six others, he looks talentless while they shine.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Death only sends him back to the beginning, and the loop he cannot escape becomes both his only gift and the cage he wants to break.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After a war's end, a holy knight captain is sealed into a frail noble girl's body by a defeated demon king.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Tired of fighting and unable to reclaim her old form, she aims for comfort until her new family endangers her and an engagement becomes the price of proving who she is.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Fame finally arrives, but the cost is the parent he failed, and despair sends him back to childhood.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: He swears off the stage to be a better son until poverty returns, forcing him toward the set one more time.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After saving the world from rifts and horrors, a top-ranked fighter wakes years later presumed dead and craving a quiet job.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Managing a hangover soup spot is not enough when relics of his past keep selling and the nation's strongest starts watching him too closely.

entries.title: How to survive as a maid in a horror game

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: After grinding a notoriously unfair murder mystery title, a player wakes inside it as household staff.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: The young master she serves is destined to slaughter everyone under a curse, and staying alive means rewriting a script built for massacre.

storyDescriptionBlurb.t0: Peace returns after a truce between hellish and heavenly realms, until an ordinary student touches a wartime relic and remembers who he used to be.
storyDescriptionBlurb.t1: Old power rushes back with new tricks attached, and he has to decide whether a former destroyer can keep the calm world standing.
